verses.text: Aya ni amajambo Mose yabwiye Abisirayeli igihe bari bakiri mu bugaragwa, mu buseruko bw’uruzi Yorodani. Aho ni mu kiyaya citwa Araba, aharabana n’i Sufi, hagati ya Parani, Tofeli, Labani, Hazeroti na Dizahabu.
Mu bisanzwe urugendo rwo kuva ku musozi Horebu gushika i Kadeshi Baruneya rwomara imisi icumi n’umwe gusa ujanye inzira ica ku musozi wa Seyiri.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ine, ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwawo kw’icumi na rimwe, Mose abarira Abisirayeli ivyo Uhoraho yamutumye kuri bo.
Ivyo vyabaye amaze kunesha Sihoni umwami w’Abamori yaba i Heshiboni, na Ogi umwami wa Bashani yaba muri Ashitaroti amuneshereje ahitwa Edireyi.
Bakiri hakurya ya Yorodani mu ntara ya Mowabu, Mose atangura gusigurira abantu ibi Vyagezwe, ababwira ati:
“ Uhoraho Imana yacu yatubaririye i Horebu ati: ‘Igihe mumaze kuri uwu musozi ni kirekire bikwiye.

Harageze ko mushingura amahema yanyu mukagenda mutumbereye imisozi y’Abamori n’iy’intara zihegereye zo muri Araba, mu misozi, mu biyaya vyo mu burengero, i Negebu no mu kiyaya cegereye ikiyaga, muje mu ntara y’Abanyakanani n’i Libani, mushike no ku ruzi runini, ari rwo Efurate.
Ehe raba, ndabahaye ico gihugu. Nimucinjiremwo mucegukire, ni igihugu Uhoraho yarahiye ko azoha ba sogokuruza banyu Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo, n’abazobakomokako bose bazokwaruka inyuma yabo.’ ”
Ico gihe narababwiye nti: “Igikorwa co kubarongora kiraremereye cane sinshobora kugikora jenyene.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu yarabagwije ku buryo mungana n’inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru.
Kandi Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza, arakabagwiza incuro igihumbi, yongere abahezagire nk’uko yabisezeranye!
Ariko none noshobora nte kwikorera ingorane zanyu, imitwaro yanyu hamwe n’imitongano yanyu jenyene?
Nuko rero nimwitoranirize mu miryango yanyu yose abantu muri mwebwe, b’abanyabwenge, batahura, kandi bubashwe, kugira ngo ndabazeze igikorwa co kubarongora.”
Mwaranyishuye muti: “Ico utubwiye ni ciza.”

Ni ho naca mfata abo bantu bo mu miryango yose bafise ubwenge kandi bubashwe, nkabaha ubutware kuri mwebwe, bamwe kurongora ibihumbi, abandi amajana, abandi mirongo itanitanu, abandi na bo cumicumi, ndabagira abatware mu miryango yanyu.

Kandi ico gihe nabwiye abacamanza banyu nti: “Muzokwumvirize imanza zizoba hagati y’abantu banyu, muheze mubacire imanza zigororotse, rwaba urubanza ruri hagati y’Abisirayeli babiri, canke hagati y’Umwisirayeli n’umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe.

Ntimuze muhengame mu guca imanza, muze mwumvirize bose, uworoshe co kimwe n’uwuhambaye. Ntimuze mutinye umuntu n’umwe, kuko urubanza muzoca ruzoba ruciwe n’Imana. Muze munzanire imanza zigoye cane, nanje nzozica.”
Ico gihe narababwiye ivyo mutegerezwa gukora vyose.

Maze nk’uko Uhoraho Imana yacu yari yabitubwiye, tuva i Horebu, tugenda twerekeye imisozi miremire yo mu gihugu c’Abamori, duca muri bwa bugaragwa bunini kandi bwica nk’uko mwabubonye, turaheza dushika i Kadeshi Baruneya.
Ndaheza ndababwira nti: “Murashitse mu misozi y’igihugu c’Abamori, ico Uhoraho Imana yacu aduhaye.
None ehe raba Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye iki gihugu. Nimuduge mucegukire nk’uko Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza, yabibabwiye. Ntimutinye, ntimucike intege.”
Ico gihe mwese mwaje aho ndi mumbwira muti: “Reka tubanze turungike abantu bagende gutata ico gihugu, hanyuma bazogaruke batubwire inzira tuzojana, n’ibisagara tuzokwinjira.”
Nanje numvise ko ico ciyumviro ari ciza, nca ntoranya abagabo icumi na babiri, umwe mu muryango wose.
Baraduga muri ico gihugu, bashika mu kiyaya ca Eshikoli, baracihweza neza.
Batora n’ivyamwa vyo muri ico gihugu, barabituzanira, batubwira inkuru zaho, bati: “Igihugu Uhoraho Imana yacu aduhaye ni ciza cane.”
Ariko ntimwashatse kuduga ngo mucinjiremwo, mugarariza Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Mwidogeye mu mahema yanyu muvuga muti: “ Uhoraho aratwanka, yadukuye muri Egiputa kugira ngo aturekurire mu maboko y’Abamori batumare.

Mbega none tuja hehe? Benewacu ko batumye imitima yacu ishongeshwa n’ubwoba. Bavuze bati: ‘Abantu baho barakomeye kuturusha kandi mu burebure baradusumba, ibisagara vyabo ni bininibinini, inzitiro zavyo zikora ku bicu, kandi twarabonyeyo n’abakomoka kuri Anaki.’ ”
Ico gihe narababwiye nti: “Ntimucike ivutu, ntimubatinye.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu agendera imbere yanyu azobagwanira, nk’uko mwabonye ibagwanira muri Egiputa,
n’igihe mwari mu bugaragwa. Harya mwarabonye ingene Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabateruye nk’uko umuvyeyi aterura umwana wiwe, gushika mushitse aha hantu.”
Ariko naho vyabaye gutyo, ntimwigeze mwizera Uhoraho Imana yanyu,
yabagendera imbere mu rugendo rwanyu rwose ari mu nkingi y’umuriro mw’ijoro no mu nkingi y’igicu ku murango, abaronderera ibibanza vyiza vyo gucumbikamwo n’inzira mushobora kujana mu rugendo.
Uhoraho yumvise ivyo muvuze araraka, aca ararahira iti:
“Nta muntu n’umwe wo muri uru runganwe rubi azobona igihugu ciza narahiye ko nzoha ba sekuruza,
kiretse Kalebu mwene Yefune. We azokibona kandi hamwe n’uruvyaro rwiwe nzobaha aho bazogeza ikirenge hose, kuko yakurikiye Uhoraho n’umutima wiwe wose.”
Kandi kubera mwebwe, na jewe Uhoraho yaranshavuriye, avuga ati: “Na wewe ntuzokwinjira muri ico gihugu.
Ariko umufasha wawe ari we Yosuwa mwene Nuni azocinjiramwo. Umutere intege kuko ari we azorongora ihanga rya Isirayeli kugira ngo rishikire iragi.
Kandi urunganwe rushasha mwibaza ko rwari rugiye kugirwa inyagano, abana banyu bataramenya ikibi n’iciza, ni bo bazocinjiramwo. Nzokibaha kibe inyegu yabo.
Ariko wewe, hindukira ufate inzira yo mu bugaragwa ija ku Kiyaga Gitukura.”

Ni ho mwishura muti: “Twacumuye k’ Uhoraho . Reka tuduge tuje kugwana nk’uko Uhoraho Imana yacu yabitubwiye.” Maze umwe wese muri mwebwe afata ibigwanisho, mwibaza ko vyoroshe gutera akarere k’imisozi muri ico gihugu.
Ariko Uhoraho arambarira ati: “Babwire uti: ‘Ntimuduge kugwana kuko atazoba ari kumwe namwe. Muzoneshwa n’abansi banyu.’ ”
Ni ho nabibabwira ariko mwanka kwumva, mugarariza itegeko ry’ Uhoraho , kandi mu bwibone bwanyu muraduga muja muri iyo misozi.
Abamori baba muri iyo misozi barasohoka kubagwanya, babirukako nk’inzuki, bagenda barabica kuva i Seyiri gushika i Horuma.
Mwagarutse muririra Uhoraho , ariko ntiyigera ashira umutima ku marira yanyu, yica amatwi ngo ntabumve.
Ni co catumye mumara i Kadeshi kirya gihe cose mwahamaze.
Ni ko guca dusubira inyuma tuja mu bugaragwa, duca mu nzira itumbereye ku Kiyaga Gitukura, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabintegetse. Tumara igihe kirekire tuzunguruka mu misozi y’i Seyiri.
Maze Uhoraho arambarira ati:
“Igihe mumaze muzunguruka muri ino misozi ni kirekire bikwiye; ubu nimuhindukire mugende mwerekeye mu buraruko.
Uhe abantu aya mategeko akurikira: ‘Mugiye guca mu gihugu ca benewanyu, abakomoka kuri Esawu, baba i Seyiri. Bazobatinya ariko namwe muze mubiyubare.
Ntimuze mubasomborotse ngo mugwane, kuko ata ntara n’imwe yabo nzobaha, sinzobaha n’ahangana n’aho umuntu yohonyoza ikirenge. Esawu namuhaye igihugu ca Seyiri ngo kibe umugabane wiwe.
Ivyokurya vyabo muzorya n’amazi yabo muzonywa, muze mubibagurire ifeza.’ ”

Imana yanyu yarahezagiye ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu, yongera ibarinda mu rugendo rwanyu rwose. Inyonga zayo zagumye ku rugendo rwanyu igihe cose mwari muri ubu bugaragwa bunini. Mu myaka mirongo ine yose Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabanye namwe, nta kintu na kimwe mwigeze mukena.

Nuko twarabandanije turengana benewacu ari bo ruvyaro rwa Esawu, baba i Seyiri. Turahindukira tuva mu nzira ica muri Araba iduga ivuye ahitwa Elati n’ahitwa Eziyoni Geberi, dufata inzira ica mu bugaragwa bw’i Mowabu.

Uhoraho arambarira ati: “Ntimugire ico mupfa n’Abanyamowabu canke ngo mubatere mugwane, kuko ntazobaha n’agatongo na gatoya mu gihugu cabo. Ahantu hitwa Ari nahahaye uruvyaro rwa Loti ngo habe umugabane wabo.”
Ubwoko bw’Abemiti ni bo bahora bahaba kera: bari abantu b’ibigatanya, kandi benshi cane, bari barebare nk’Abanaki.
Abo Bemiti co kimwe n’Abanaki, bose babita Abarefayimu, ariko Abanyamowabu bobo babita Abemiti.
Abahori ni bo bahora baba i Seyiri, ariko abo mu ruvyaro rwa Esawu barabirukanye. Barabatikije, bifatira igihugu cabo nk’uko Abisirayeli babikoze ku gihugu Uhoraho yabahaye ngo bacegukire.
Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Nimuhaguruke mujabuke ikiyaya c’i Zeredi.” Natwe turahaguruka turakijabuka.

Hari haheze imyaka mirongo itatu n’umunani kuva duhagurutse tuva i Kadeshi Baruneya gushika tujabuke ikiyaya c’i Zeredi. Ariko ico gihe, urunganwe rwose rw’abagabo bashobora kuja mu ntambara rwari rumaze guhonera mu bugaragwa nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabibarahiye.
Ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwagumye kubagwaniriza aho dushagaje kugeza kubamaze bose.
Igihe uwa nyuma wo muri urwo runganwe rw’abashobora kuja mu ntambara yari amaze gupfa,
Uhoraho aca arambarira ati:
“Uwu musi mugiye guca muri Ari, mu ntara y’i Mowabu.
Nimwashikira Abamoni, ntimuze mubasomborotse canke ngo mubatere kugira ngo mugwane, kuko ntazobaha n’agatongo na gatoya mu gihugu c’Abamoni. Nagihaye uruvyaro rwa Loti ngo kibe inyegu yabo.”
Ico na co nyene cari kizwi nk’igihugu c’Abarefayimu bahoze bakibamwo, ariko Abamoni babita Abazamuzumi.
Bari abantu b’inkomezi kandi benshi, barebare nk’Abanaki. Uhoraho abatikiriza imbere y’Abamoni, na bo baca barabirukana bifatira ico gihugu.
Uhoraho yari yabikoze gutyo ku bantu bo mu ruvyaro rwa Esawu bahoze baba i Seyiri, igihe yatikiriza Abahori imbere yabo. Barabirukanye baca baba mu gihugu cabo gushika n’uno musi.
Kandi ivyo vyarashitse no ku bantu bitwa Abawimu bahoze baba mu mihana ishika i Gaza, Abakafutori bakomotse kuri Kafutori barabaranduye, baca begukira igihugu cabo.
Maze Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Haguruka mujabuke akagezi Arunoni. Ehe nshize mu maboko yanyu Sihoni Umwamori, umwami wa Heshiboni, n’igihugu ciwe. Nimumutere mutangure gufata ico gihugu.
Uyu musi nyene ngira ntangure guteza igihumura n’ubwoba amahanga yose ari musi y’izuba. Bazokwumva inkuru zanyu bahinde agashitsi bahagarike imitima kubera mwebwe.”
Tukiri mu bugaragwa bw’i Kedemoti, narungitse intumwa kuri Sihoni umwami w’i Heshiboni, ndamusaba ko tugiriranira amahoro, ndamubwira nti:
“Nimutureke duce mu gihugu canyu. Tuzoguma mu nzira itumbereye ducamwo turengana, ntituzokikama ngo tuje i buryo canke i bubamfu.
Muze mutugurisheko ivyokurya tuzorya n’amazi tuzonywa, tuzobigura amahera. Ico tubasavye ni uko mwotureka tugaca mu gihugu canyu gusa;
nk’uko abo mu ruvyaro rwa Esawu baba i Seyiri co kimwe n’Abanyamowabu baba muri Ari baturetse turarengana; kugeza tujabutse uruzi Yorodani, tugashika mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yacu aduhaye.”
Ariko Sihoni umwami w’i Heshiboni aratwankira ko tuhaca, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yari yamukomantaje umutima ntiyumvira, kugira ngo imutange mu maboko yanyu, nk’uko mubibona uwu musi.
Uhoraho arambarira ati: “Murabona ko natanguye kubaha Sihoni n’igihugu ciwe. Nuko rero nimucinjire, mucegukire.”
Igihe Sihoni n’ingabo ziwe baza kudutegerera i Yahazi ngo batugwanye,
Uhoraho Imana yacu amutanga mu maboko yanyu, muramwica, mumwicana n’abahungu biwe n’ingabo ziwe zose.
Ico gihe twateye ibisagara vyiwe vyose turabisangangura: abagabo, abagore, abana, ntihasigara n’uwo kubara inkuru.
Ariko ibitungwa n’ibindi vyose twanyaze mu bisagara twafashe, twarabigumije biba ivyacu.
Kandi Uhoraho Imana yacu yadufashije gufata Aroweri, igisagara kiri ku nkengera y’umwonga Arunoni no gushika kure i Gileyadi, nta gisagara na kimwe catunaniye. Uhoraho Imana yacu yabiduhaye vyose.
Kandi dukurikije ivyo Uhoraho Imana yacu yatubwiye, nta kintu na kimwe twatwaye mu ntara y’Abamoni, canke mu ntara iri ku nkengera z’uruzi Yaboki, canke mu ntara yegereye ibisagara biri mu misozi.

headings.text: Ingene umwami Sihoni w’i Heshiboni yatsinzwe

verses.text: Hanyuma twarahindukiye dufata inzira iduga ija i Bashani, maze Ogi umwami w’i Bashani n’ingabo ziwe zose baza kudutegera kugira ngo tugwanire ahitwa Edireyi.
Uhoraho arambarira ati: “Ntimumutinye kuko namutanze mu maboko yanyu, we n’ingabo ziwe zose n’igihugu ciwe. Muze mumukorere nk’ivyo mwakoreye Sihoni umwami w’Abamori, yaganza i Heshiboni.”
Nuko Uhoraho Imana yacu aduha intsinzi kuri Ogi umwami w’i Bashani no ku ngabo ziwe zose. Twarabatikije ntitwasigaza n’umuntu n’umwe.
Ico gihe twafashe ibisagara vyiwe vyose. Mu bisagara mirongo itandatu bari bafise nta na kimwe tutabanyaze, mu ntara yose ya Arugobu, mu bwami bwa Ogi i Bashani.
Ivyo bisagara vyose vyari bikingiwe n’inzitiro ndende z’ibihome hamwe n’inzugi zikomeye n’ivyugazo vyazo, hakaba kandi hariho n’imihana myinshi itagira inzitiro.
Bose twarabatikije nk’uko twabigize kuri Sihoni umwami w’i Heshiboni, tugatikiza ibisagara vyose n’ababibamwo: abagabo, abagore n’abana.
Ariko ibitungwa vyabo n’ivyo twanyaze mu bisagara vyabo twarabitwaye biba ivyacu.
Nuko dufata ibihugu vy’abo bami babiri b’Abamori baba mu buseruko bwa Yorodani, uhereye ku kagezi ka Arunoni ugashika kure ku musozi Herumoni.
Abanyesidoni uwo musozi Herumoni bawita Siriyoni, Abamori na bo bakawita Seniri.
Twafashe ibisagara biri mu biyaya vyose, dufata n’intara ya Gileyadi yose, dufata n’i Bashani hose gushika kure ahitwa Saleka na Edireyi, ibisagara vy’umwami Ogi w’i Bashani.

Umwami Ogi w’i Bashani ni we wenyene yari agisigaye mu Barefayimu. Uburiri bwiwe bwari bukozwe mu vyuma, bukagira ingero z’igice c’ukuboko icenda z’uburebure n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zine z’ubwaguke. Buracari i Raba ho mu Bamoni gushika n’ubu.

Mu ntara twegukiye ico gihe, umuryango wa Reyubeni n’uwa Gadi ni yo nahaye intara y’amaja ruguru ya Aroweri, uciye ku kagezi ka Arunoni, ugashiramwo n’igice c’intara irimwo imisozi miremire y’i Gileyadi, hamwe n’ibisagara vyaho.

Igice ca Gileyadi cari gisigaye hamwe n’intara yose ya Bashani, ari bwo bwami bwa Ogi, nahahaye igice c’umuryango wa Manase. (Iyo ntara yose y’i Arugobu i Bashani kera yari izwi nk’intara y’Abarefayimu.
Yayiro, wo mu ruvyaro rwa Manase, afata intara yose ya Arugobu, ari ho hitwa Bashani, gushika ku rubibe rw’Abageshuri n’Abamayaka; yaciye imwitirirwa, ni co gituma gushika n’ubu yitwa Havoti Yayiro.)
Gileyadi nahahaye umuryango wa Makiri.

Ariko, imiryango ya Reyubeni n’iya Gadi nayihaye intara iva i Gileyadi, ikamanuka igashika ku kagezi k’uruzi Arunoni (nko hagati y’ako kagezi ni ho hari urubibe), kandi hirya ku ruzi Yaboki ni ho hari urubibe rw’Abamoni.
Urubibe rwabo rwo mu burengero ni uruzi Yorodani mu kiyaya Araba, uvuye i Kinereti gushika ku kiyaga Araba, ari co Kiyaga c’Umunyu, ukamanuka hepfo y’umusozi Pisiga mu buseruko.
Ico gihe nabahaye itegeko nti: “ Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabahaye iki gihugu ngo mucegukire. Ariko abagabo bose bashobora kuja mu ntambara ni bo bazobanza kujabuka Yorodani imbere y’Abisirayeli bandi.
Ariko abagore n’abana banyu, n’ibitungwa vyanyu, biboneka ko ari vyinshi, bigume mu bisagara nabahaye,

gushika Uhoraho atanze impore mu bandi Bisirayeli bose nk’uko namwe yayibahaye, na bo bakegukira igihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu ibahaye hakurya ya Yorodani. Inyuma y’aho, umwumwe wese muri mwebwe arashobora gusubira mu mugabane namuhaye.”
Ico gihe nategetse Yosuwa nti: “Wariboneye n’amaso yawe ivyo Uhoraho yakoreye ba bami babiri. Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobigenza gutyo no ku bundi bwami bwose buri iyo mugiye.
Ntimuzobatinye; Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobagwanira.”
Ico gihe narasenze Uhoraho , ndamwinginga nti:
“Ewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, weretse abasavyi bawe ubukuru bwawe n’inkomezi z’ukuboko kwawe. Mbega ni iyihe Mana yindi mw’ijuru no mw’isi yokora ibikorwa bihambaye nk’ivyo ukora?
Ndeka njabuke nshike hakurya mbone ubwiza bwa kiriya gihugu co hakurya ya Yorodani, kirya gihugu ciza c’imisozi miremire hamwe na Libani.”
Ariko kubera mwebwe Uhoraho yari yarandakiye, ntiyemera no kunyumviriza. Yavuze ati: “Geza aho, ivyo birakwiye. Singomba kuzosubira kukwumva umbarira ikintu na kimwe kuri ivyo.
Haguruka uduge ku musozi Pisiga, urabe mu burengero, mu buraruko, mu buseruko no mu bumanuko, wihweze ico gihugu n’amaso yawe, kuko utazojabuka Yorodani.
Ariko tegura Yosuwa, umutere intege kandi umukomeze, kuko ari we azorongora aba bantu, akabajabukana Yorodani akabafasha kwegukira ico gihugu uzobona.”
Duca tuguma mu kiyaya kiri hafi ya Beti-Peyori.

headings.text: Ugutsindwa kwa Ogi umwami w’i Bashani

verses.text: None rero yemwe Bisirayeli, mwumvirize amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe ngira ndabigishe. Muyakurikize kugira ngo mubone kubaho, mwinjire mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza ibahaye, mugifate kibe inyegu yanyu.
Ntihagire ico muzokwongera ku vyo ndababwira, kandi ntihagire n’ico muzokurako, ariko mukurikize ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu ngira ndabahe.
Mwariboneye n’amaso yanyu ivyo Uhoraho yakoze kubera Bayali-Peyori. Uhoraho yatikije abo muri mwebwe basenze Bayali, imana y’i Peyori.
Ariko mwese abagumye k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu muracariho gushika n’uwu musi.
Raba, nabigishije amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe nk’uko Uhoraho Imana yanje yari yabintegetse, kugira ngo muzobikurikize nimwashika mu gihugu mugira mwinjire ngo mugifate kibe inyegu yanyu.

Muzobikurikize vyose kandi muvyitondere, kuko ni vyo bizokwerekana ubwenge bwanyu n’ugutahura kwanyu mu yandi mahanga kuko azokwumva ivyerekeye ivyo vyagezwe akavuga ati: “Koko rino hanga ni iry’abantu b’ubwenge kandi batahura.”
Mbega hari irindi hanga rihambaye, rifise imana ziba hafi yaryo nk’uko Uhoraho Imana yacu aba hafi yacu igihe cose tumusenze?
Kandi hari ihanga ririho rihambaye, mu kuba rifise amabwirizwa n’Ivyagezwe bigororotse nk’ivyo ndiko ndabashira imbere uno musi?
Ariko mubibere maso, kandi mwiyubare ntimuzokwibagire ivyo amaso yanyu yabonye, canke ngo mubireke bive mu mitima yanyu ubuzima bwanyu bwose. Muzovyigishe abana banyu n’abuzukuru banyu.

Ntimuzokwibagire igihe mwahagarara imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu ku musozi Horebu, maze Imana ikambarira iti: “Koraniriza abantu bose imbere yanje kugira ngo bumve amajambo yanje hanyuma bige kunyubaha igihe cose co kubaho kwabo muri ico gihugu kandi bazoshobore kuvyigisha abana babo.”
Mwibuke ko mwegereye mugahagarara ku ntango y’uwo musozi mu gihe imbeya zarabagiza ziduga hejuru cane mw’ijuru, hari igicu cirabura cane n’umwijima mwinshi bikawutwikira.
Uhoraho yavuganye namwe ari muri uwo muriro. Mwarumvise ijwi ry’amajambo yiwe ariko ntimwigeze mumubona. Humvikana ijwi gusa.
Yabahaye isezerano, ari yo mabwirizwa icumi, ayo yabategetse gukurikiza, akanayandika ku bisate bibiri vy’amabuye.
Uhoraho yantegetse kubigisha amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe kugira ngo muze mubikurikize nimwashika mu gihugu mugiye kwegukira kikaba icanyu, mumaze kujabuka Yorodani.
Muze mwirinde! Nta shusho y’ikintu na kimwe mwabonye umusi Uhoraho yavuganira namwe ku musozi Horebu ari mu muriro. Rero muze mwirinde cane,
ntimuzokwiyononeshe ikintu na kimwe, kandi ntihazogire ikigirwamana na kimwe mwikorera, caba mw’ishusho y’umugabo canke mw’ishusho y’umugore,
caba mw’ishusho y’igikoko co kw’isi canke y’inyoni zo mu kirere,
caba mw’ishusho y’igikwega inda hasi canke y’ifi yo mu kiyaga.

Kandi nimwarangamiza mu kirere mukabona izuba, ukwezi canke inyenyeri, iryo sinzi ry’ivyo kw’ijuru, ntimuze mupfukame ngo musenge ibintu Uhoraho Imana yanyu yashiriyeho amahanga yose ari musi y’ijuru.
Ariko mweho, Uhoraho yarabateruye abakura mw’itanure ry’umuriro rivugutira ivyuma ari ryo Egiputa kugira ngo abagire abantu biwe, inyegu yiharije, nk’uko muri uno musi.
Uhoraho yarandakiye kubera mwebwe, arandahira avyeruye ko ntazojabuka Yorodani ngo ninjire mu gihugu ciza Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye ngo kibe inyegu yanyu.
Nzopfira muri kino gihugu, sinzojabuka Yorodani. Ariko mwebwe muzojabuka mufate ico gihugu ciza kibe icanyu.
None rero mwirinde, ntimuzokwibagire isezerano Uhoraho Imana yanyu yagiranye namwe, ntimuze mukore ikigirwamana na kimwe mw’ishusho y’ikintu na kimwe Uhoraho Imana yababujije.
Kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari umuriro utongora, akaba n’Imana ipfuha.

Nimwamara kuvyara abana mukaronka n’abuzukuru, mukaba muri ico gihugu imyaka myinshi, hanyuma mukononekara, mukibazira ibigirwamana, mugakora ibitabereye mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mukayitera kuraka,
ntoye ijuru n’isi ngo bimbere ivyabona uwu musi, ko muzohonera mu gihugu mugiye kwegukira hakurya ya Yorodani ngo kibe icanyu. Ntimuzokirambiramwo, ahubwo nta kabuza muzorandurwa.
Uhoraho azobasanzaza mu mahanga, kandi bake muri mwebwe ni bo bazorokokera muri ayo mahanga Uhoraho azobasanzarizamwo.
Muri ayo mahanga muzosenga imana zakozwe n’amaboko y’abantu, izo babaje mu biti no mu mabuye, zitabona, zitumva, zitarya canke ngo zimoterwe.
Ariko nimwaharonderera Uhoraho Imana yanyu, muzomubona nimwamuronderana imitima n’imishaha yanyu yose.
Nimwaba mu mibabaro, ayo magorwa yose akabashikira, hazogera igihe mugaruke k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu mumwubahe.
Kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari Imana y’imbabazi, ntizobaheba canke ngo ibatikize, canke ngo yibagire isezerano yagiranye na ba sogokuruza, iryo yashimangiye n’indahiro yayo.

Murabaza muhereye ku vyabaye muri kahise, ivyabaye mutarabaho, muhereye igihe Imana yarema umuntu kw’isi gushitsa n’ubu, mubaze muhereye ku ntango y’ijuru mugashitsa ku mpera yaryo. Mbega hari ikintu gihambaye nk’ico cari bwaboneke canke ngo mucumve?
Mbega hari irindi hanga rirumva ijwi ry’Imana ivugira mu muriro, nk’uko mwaryiyumviye, kandi mukabaho?

Mbega hari iyindi mana yoba yaragerageje kwikurira ihanga rimwe mu rindi no kuryihariza, ikoresheje ibimenyetso, ibitangaza n’utwumiza hamwe n’intambara; ikoresheje kandi ukuboko kwayo kw’inkomezi kandi kuramvuye, canke mu gukora ibikorwa bihambaye nk’ivyo Uhoraho Imana yanyu yakoreye mu maso yanyu mu gihugu ca Egiputa?
Ivyo vyose mwavyeretswe kugira ngo mumenye ko Uhoraho ari we Mana wenyene, kandi ko ata yindi iriho.
Yabumvishije ijwi ryayo iri mw’ijuru kugira ngo ibigishe. Yaberetse umuriro uhambaye, mwumva n’amajambo yayo ava muri uwo muriro.
Kuko yakunze ba sogokuruza, igatoranya uruvyaro rwabo, ikabakuza muri Egiputa, ukugaragara kwayo n’ububasha bwayo bukomeye,
yirukana imbere yanyu amahanga manini kandi akomeye kubarusha, ibashikana mu gihugu cabo, irakibaha muracegukira nk’uko biri uno musi.
Nuko rero mwame mwibuka mu mitima yanyu ko Uhoraho ari we Mana hejuru mw’ijuru no hasi kw’isi, kandi ko ata yindi Mana iriho.

Muzokurikize amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe vyayo, ivyo ndabahaye uwu musi, kugira ngo ivyanyu n’ivy’uruvyaro rwanyu bizogende neza, muzorambire mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye ngo kizobe icanyu ibihe vyose.
Nuko Mose atoranya ibisagara bitatu vyo hakurya ya Yorodani,
ivyo uwuzokwica umuntu wese azohungiramwo, iyo yishe umubanyi wiwe akaba abikoze atabishaka, atahora amuhigira canke ngo abe yahora amufitiye urwanko. Azohungira mu gisagara kimwe muri ivyo bitatu.

Ivyo bisagara vyari ibi: Bezeri co mu bugaragwa mu misozi migufimigufi ku bantu bo mu muryango wa Reyubeni, Ramoti c’i Gileyadi ku bantu bo mu muryango wa Gadi, hamwe na Golani c’i Bashani ku bantu bo mu muryango wa Manase.
Ibi ni vyo vyagezwe Mose yahaye Abisirayeli.
Ng’ibi ivyashinzwe, amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe Mose yahaye Abisirayeli igihe bari bavuye muri Egiputa,

igihe bari bacumbitse mu kiyaya ca Beti-Peyori hakurya ya Yorodani, mu gihugu cahoze gitwarwa na Sihoni umwami w’Abamori, yaba i Heshiboni, yaneshejwe na Mose afadikanije n’Abisirayeli igihe bari bavuye muri Egiputa.
Begukiye igihugu ciwe hamwe n’igihugu catwarwa na Ogi, umwami w’i Bashani; abami babiri b’Abamori baba hakurya ya Yorodani.
Ivyo bihugu vyava ahitwa Aroweri no ku nkengera z’akuzi Arunoni bigashika ku musozi Siyoni, ari wo Herumoni,
bafata na Araba hakurya ya Yorodani, gushika ku Kiyaga c’Umunyu co mu kiyaya Araba, ku ntango z’umuzosi Pisiga.
Mose Ahamagara Abisirayeli bose arabakoranya, ababwira ati: Tega amatwi yemwe Bisirayeli! Umviriza ivyagezwe n’amabwirizwa ndabahaye uwu musi, kugira ngo muyige mwongere muyakurikize.
Uhoraho Imana yacu yagiranye isezerano natwe ku musozi Horebu.
Iryo sezerano Uhoraho ntiyarigiranye na ba sogokuruza, yarigiranye na twebwe, twebwe abakiriho uno musi.
Uhoraho yivuganiye namwe imbonankubone ari mu muriro kuri wa musozi.
Ico gihe nari nk’umuhuza hagati y’ Uhoraho namwe kugira ngo ndabashikirize amajambo y’ Uhoraho , kuko mwari mwatinye umuriro ntimwaduga ku musozi. Yaravuze iti:
“Ndi Uhoraho Imana yawe, yagukuye muri Egiputa, igihugu wabayemwo uri umugurano.
Ntukagire izindi mana umbangikanya.
Ntukibazire ikigirwamana mw’ishusho y’ikintu na kimwe, caba ico hejuru mw’ijuru canke hasi kw’isi, canke i kuzimu, canke mu biyaga.
Ntuzovyikubite imbere canke ngo ubikorere, kuko jewe Uhoraho Imana yawe ndi Imana ipfuha, mpanira abana ivyaha vya ba sekuruza babo gushika ku runganwe rwa gatatu n’urwa kane rw’abanyanka.
Ariko abankunda bagakurikiza amabwirizwa yanje, ndabereka urukundo gushika ku runganwe rw’igihumbi.
Ntukavuge izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yawe ku busabusa. Kuko Uhoraho atazobura guhana abakoresha izina ryiwe ukutariko.
Wame uhimbaza umusi w’Isabato, uzokwame ari umusi wejejwe nk’uko Uhoraho Imana yawe yabigutegetse.
Uze ukore ibikorwa vyawe vyose mu misi itandatu,

ariko umusi w’indwi ni Isabato y’ Uhoraho Imana yawe. Kuri uwo musi, ntuzogire igikorwa na kimwe uwukorako, yaba wewe, umuhungu canke umukobwa wawe, yaba umukozi wawe w’umuhungu canke w’umukobwa, impfizi, indogoba canke ikindi gitungwa cawe ico ari co cose, canke umunyamahanga aba iwawe, kugira ngo umukozi wawe w’umuhungu n’uw’umukobwa bazoruhuke nk’uko nawe uzoba uruhutse.
Mwibuke ko mwari abagurano muri Egiputa, kandi ko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabakujeyo ikiganza gikomeye, n’ukuramvura ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi. Ni co gituma Uhoraho yabategetse guhimbaza umusi w’Isabato.
Wubahe so na nyoko nk’uko Uhoraho yabigutegetse, kugira ngo uzorambire mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yawe iguhaye, kandi ivyawe bizogende neza.
Ntukice.
Ntugasambane.
Ntukibe.
Ntukarementanirize ibinyoma mugenzawe.
Ntukipfuze umugore wa mugenzawe. Ntukipfuze inzu yiwe canke itongo, umukozi wiwe w’umuhungu canke w’umukobwa, inka yiwe canke indogoba, canke ikindi kintu cose ca mugenzawe.”

Ibi ni vyo vyagezwe Uhoraho yavuze n’ijwi rirenga abibwira ikoraniro ryanyu kuri wa musozi ari mu muriro, mu gicu no mu mwijima ukomeye; kandi nta kindi yongeyeko. Yaciye avyandika ku bisate bibiri vy’amabuye, arabimpa.
Ariko igihe mwumva ijwi riva mu mwijima, kandi umusozi wuzuyeko imbeya z’umuriro, abatware b’imiryango yanyu bose baje aho ndi.
Barambarira bati: “ Uhoraho Imana yacu yatweretse ubwiza bwiwe n’ubukuru bwiwe, kandi twiyumviye ijwi ryayo ivugira mu muriro. Uwu musi twiboneye ko Imana ishobora kuvugana n’umuntu kandi akabaho.
None rero ni kubera iki twokwishira mw’irinde ry’urupfu? Uhoraho Imana yacu niyasubira kuvugana natwe, nta kabuza tuzopfa. Urya muriro uhambaye uratuyigiza.
Mbega hari umuntu buntu ashobora kwumva ijwi ry’Imana ivugira mu muriro nk’uko twayumvise, hanyuma akabaho?
None rero nabe ari wewe ugenda wegere wumvirize ico Uhoraho Imana yacu avuga, hanyuma ugaruke utubwire ivyo yakubariye vyose, natwe tuzokwumvira tubikurikize.”
Uhoraho yarabumvise igihe mwambarira ukwo, araheza ambarira ati: “Niyumviye ivyo abo bantu bakubwiye, kandi ivyo bavuze vyose ni vyiza.
Ese imitima yabo yokwama yicisha bugufi, bakantinya bakongera bakanyubaha, bakama bakurikiza amabwirizwa yanje, kugira ngo ivyabo bize bigende neza kuri bo no ku ruvyaro rwabo, ibihe vyose.
Genda ubabwire basubire mu mahema yabo.
Ariko wewe uce ugaruka ugume ngaha ndaguhe ivyagezwe, amabwirizwa n’amategeko uzobigisha, kugira ngo bazobikurikize nibamara gushika mu gihugu ngira ndabahe ngo bacegukire.”
None rero mwiyubare kugira ngo muzokore ivyo Uhoraho Imana yanyu abategeka vyose, ntihagire na kimwe muzoca i ruhande.
Muzogume mu nzira Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobereka, ni ho ivyanyu bizogenda neza, mukarambira muri ico gihugu muhawe ngo mucegukire.

Aya ni yo mategeko, amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe Uhoraho Imana yanyu yampaye ngo ndabibigishe, kugira ngo muzobikurikize nimwamara gushika mu gihugu, ico mugira mwinjiremwo mujabutse Yorodani mukacegukira,

kugira ngo mwe n’abana banyu n’abuzukuru banyu muze mwame mutinya bifatanije n’ukwubaha Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ukubaho kwanyu kwose, mukurikiza aya mabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe ndabaha uwu musi, kugira ngo muzonezerererwe kurambira muri ico gihugu.
Tega amatwi yewe Isirayeli, kandi witeho cane kwumvira kugira ngo ivyawe bizogende neza, ugwirire cane mu gihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki, nk’uko Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza yabigusezeraniye.
Tega amatwi, yewe Isirayeli: Uhoraho Imana yacu, ni yo Mana imwe rudende.
Ukundishe Uhoraho Imana yawe umutima wawe wose, umushaha wawe wose, n’inkomezi zawe zose.
Aya mabwirizwa ndabahaye uwu musi azokwame mu mitima yanyu.
Muzokwame muyigisha abana banyu. Muzohore muyaganirako mwicaye i muhira canke muri ku rugendo, iyo mugiye kuryama n’iyo muvyutse.
Muzoyabohere ku maboko, muyambare no mu ruhanga nk’ivyibutso.
Muzovyandike ku bishimaryango vy’amazu yanyu, no ku nzugi z’amarembo yanyu.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu niyabashikana mu gihugu yasezeraniye ba sogokuruza Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo ko azokibaha, igihugu cuzuye ibisagara bininibinini mutubatse,
amazu yuzuye ivyiza vyinshi mutarondeye, amariba mutimvye, inzabibu n’imyelayo mutateye maze mukabirya mugahaga,
muze mwirinde, ntimuze mwibagire Uhoraho yabakuye muri Egiputa, mu gihugu c’ubuja.
Wubahe Uhoraho Imana yawe, abe ari yo yonyene ukorera. Niwagira indahiro, uze urahire mw’izina ryayo gusa.
Ntimuzosenge imana z’amahanga azoba abakikuje;
kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu iba muri mwebwe ari Imana ipfuha. Uburake bwayo bwobaziriringira ikabarandura, ikabakura kw’isi.
Ntimukagerageze Uhoraho Imana yanyu nk’uko mwabigize i Masa.
Ariko muzokurikize amabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, hamwe n’ivyagezwe n’amategeko yose yabahaye.
Muzokore ibiroranye mu nyonga z’Imana, kugira ngo ivyanyu bizogende neza. Ni ho muzokwinjira mukegukira ico gihugu ciza cane Uhoraho yasezeraniye ba sogokuruza ko azokibaha, mukakibamwo.
Muze mwirukane abansi banyu bose baba muri ico gihugu, nk’uko Uhoraho yabivuze.
Mu myaka iri imbere abana banyu bazobabaza bati: “Mbega ivyagezwe, amabwirizwa n’amategeko Uhoraho Imana yacu yabahaye bisigura iki?”
Muzobishure muti: “Twari abagurano ba Farawo muri Egiputa, ariko Uhoraho yadukujeyo ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi.
Uhoraho yakoze ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza biteye ubwoba, bishika kuri Egiputa no kuri Farawo n’abantu biwe amaso yacu avyibonera.
Kandi, yadukuye muri Egiputa kugira ngo aduhe igihugu yari yarasezeraniye ba sogokuruza bacu.
Uhoraho yadutegetse gukurikiza aya mategeko no gutinya Uhoraho Imana yacu bifatanije no kumwubaha, kugira ngo ivyacu bizogende neza, twongere turambe nk’uko biri uno musi.
Kuko nitwakurikiza neza ibi vyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana yacu vyose nk’uko yabidutegetse, ni vyo bizoba ukugororoka kwacu.”

Uhoraho Imana yanyu niyabashikana mu gihugu mugiye kwinjiramwo ngo mucegukire, akirukana imbere yanyu ayandi mahanga menshi ari yo y’Abaheti, Abagirugashi, Abamori, Abanyakanani, Abaperizi, Abahiwi n’Abayebusi, ari yo mahanga indwi maninimanini kubasumvya;
kandi Uhoraho Imana yanyu niyamara kuyatanga mu maboko yanyu mukayanesha, muzoyarandure muyamare. Ntihazogire isezerano na rimwe mugirana na yo, kandi ntimuzoyagirire impuhwe.
Ntimuzokwabirane na bo. Ntimuzobahe abakobwa banyu kandi n’abahungu banyu ntibazosabe abakobwa babo,
kuko bohava batesha inzira nziza abahungu banyu, bakamvako bagakorera izindi mana, hanyuma uburake bwanje jewe Uhoraho bukaka kuri bo nk’umuriro, nkabarandura mu kanya isase.
Uku abe ari ko muzobagenza: muzosambure ibicaniro vyabo, mumenagure n’amabuye y’aho batangira ibimazi vyabo, mutemagure inkingi bashingiye ikigirwamana Ashera, muturire n’ibigirwamana vyabo vyose.
Kuko muri ihanga ryejejwe Imana yitoranirije. Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabatoranije mu yandi mahanga yose yo kw’isi, kugira ngo mube abantu biwe, itunga rihambaye yiharije.
Uhoraho ntiyabakundishije umutima wiwe wose kubera mwasumvya ubwinshi abandi bose, ahubwo mwari ihanga rito ku yandi mahanga yose.

Ariko ni kubera Uhoraho yabakunze, agashitsa indahiro yarahiye ba sogokuruza. Ni vyo vyatumye abazana n’ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi, akabarokora mu gihugu c’ubuja, mu bubasha bwa Farawo, umwami wa Egiputa.
None rero mumenye ko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari Imana. Ni umwizigirwa, azigama isezerano ry’urukundo gushika ku runganwe rw’igihumbi ku bamukunda bagakurikiza amabwirizwa yiwe.
Ariko abamwanka azobahemba ukubatikiza, kandi ntazoteba.
None rero, muzokurikize aya mabwirizwa, ivyagezwe n’amategeko ndabahaye uno musi.
Nimwayashirako umutima, mukitwararika kuyakurikiza, Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoguma mw’isezerano ry’urukundo yabasezeraniye, nk’uko yabirahiye ba sogokuruza banyu.

Azobakunda, abahezagire, yongere abagwize. Azohezagira imbuto zo mu nda zanyu, ivyimburwa vyo mu matongo yanyu nk’ingano, umuvinyu mushasha n’amavuta ya Elayo, kandi azohezagira n’inyana z’ibitungwa vyanyu hamwe n’imyagazi y’imikuku yanyu mu gihugu yarahiye ba sogokuruza ko azokibaha.
Muzohezagirwa gusumba ayandi mahanga yose, nta n’umwe wo muri mwebwe azoba ingumba, kandi nta n’igitungwa na kimwe canyu kizoba ingumba.
Uhoraho azobakingira ingwara zose. Ntazobateza ingwara n’imwe nk’iziteye ubwoba mwabonye muri Egiputa, ariko azoziteza abansi banyu.
Muzotikize abantu bose Uhoraho azotanga mu maboko yanyu. Ntimuze mubagirire akagongwe kandi ntimuzosenge imana zabo, kuko zobabera umutego.
Mushobora kwibwira mu mitima muti: “Aya mahanga aradusumvya inkomezi. Mbega tuzobirukana dute?”
Ariko ntimuzogire ubwoba, mwibuke ivyo Uhoraho Imana yanyu yakoreye Farawo na Egiputa yose.
Mwariboneye n’amaso yanyu, imibabaro, ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza, ukuboko gukomeye kandi kuramvuye kw’ Uhoraho , yabakujeyo. Uhoraho Imana yanyu azokorera nka birya ayo mahanga yose mutinya.
Ikirengeye ivyo, Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobarungikamwo amavubi gushika n’aho n’uwabinyegeje azoranduka.
Ntibazobatere ubwoba kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari muri mwebwe ari Imana y’igitangaza.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu azokwirukana amahanga imbere yanyu, bukebuke. Ntazobakundira ko muyirukanira icarimwe yose, kuko ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba vyohava bibabana vyinshi.
Ariko Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobatanga mu maboko yanyu, abateze ukuzazanirwa gushika batikiye bose.
Azotanga abami babo mu maboko yanyu, namwe muzozimanganya amazina yabo musi y’ijuru. Nta n’umwe azobahagarara imbere ngo abagwanye; muzobarandura bose.
Ibishushanyo vy’imana zabo muze mubiturire. Ntimuze mwipfuze ifeza n’inzahabu zabo, kandi ntimuze mubitware, kuko muzoba muguye mu mutego wabo, kuko ari ibisesema k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntihaze hagire igisesema na kimwe mwinjiza mu mazu yanyu, kuko mwohava muranduka, kandi ari vyo bikwiye kuranduka. Mutegerezwa kwanka ibintu nk’ivyo kuko vyagenewe kuzorandurwa.
Mube maso kugira ngo mukurikize ibi vyagezwe ndabahaye uwu musi, ni ho muzobaho, mukagwira, mukinjira, mukegukira igihugu Uhoraho yasezeraniye ba sogokuruza.

Mwibuke ingene Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabarongoye mu bugaragwa muri iyi myaka mirongo ine yose, kugira ngo ibacishe bugufi yongere ibagerageze, imenye ibiri mu mitima yanyu, irabe ko muzokurikiza amabwirizwa yayo.

Yabacishije bugufi mu kubareka ngo musonze, hanyuma ibagaburira manu, iyo mutari bwigere mumenya, yaba mwebwe canke ba sogokuruza banyu, kugira ngo ibigishe ko umuntu adatungwa n’indya gusa, ariko ko ashobora gutungwa n’ijambo ryose rivuye mu kanwa k’ Uhoraho .
Impuzu zanyu ntizigeze zishira, kandi n’ibirenge vyanyu ntivyigeze bivyimba muri iyo myaka mirongo ine yose.
None rero mutahure mu mitima yanyu ko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yariko arabatoza indero nka kurya umuvyeyi atoza indero umwana wiwe.
Mukurikize amabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mugendere mu nzira ziwe, mumutinye bifatanije no kumwubaha.
Kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu abajanye mu gihugu ciza cane, igihugu kirimwo imigende y’amazi n’amariba, n’inzuzi zitemba mu biyaya no mu misozi,
igihugu kirimwo ingano, imizabibu n’imisukoni, amakomamanga, amavuta ya elayo n’ubuki;
igihugu kitigera kibura ivyokurya, ata na kimwe kibuzeyo. Igihugu usanga amabuye yaco ari ubutare n’imitumba mushobora kwimbamwo ubundi butare bw’umujumbu.
Nimwamara kurya mugahaga, muzoshime Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabahaye igihugu ciza nk’ico.
Muze mwirinde ntimuze mwibagire Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ngo munanirwe no gukurikiza amabwirizwa, ivyagezwe n’amategeko vyiwe, ivyo ndabaha uwu musi.
Ahandi ho nimwarya mugahaga, mukubaka amazu mezameza yo kubamwo mu bisagara,
ibitungwa vyanyu bikagwira, inzahabu n’ifeza mufise bikiyongera,
imitima yanyu izokwishira hejuru, mwibagire Uhoraho Imana yanyu, yabakuye muri Egiputa, mu gihugu c’ubuja.
Yabarongoye mu bugaragwa buteye ubwoba kandi bwica, igihugu c’inyota kitagiramwo amazi, kirimwo inzoka z’ubumara na sikoropiyo. Yabakuriye amazi mu gitandara.
Yabahaye manu mu bugaragwa, ikintu ba sogokuruza banyu batigeze bamenya, kugira ngo ibacishe bugufi yongere ibagerageze ku bw’ineza yanyu.
Ivyo vyose yabikoze kugira ngo ntihaze hagire uwibwira mu mutima ati: “Ubu butunzi bwose naburonse kubera inkomezi n’ibikorwa vyanje.”
Ariko Muzokwame mwibuka Uhoraho Imana yanyu kuko ari yo ibashoboza kuronka ubutunzi, kugira ngo ishitse isezerano yaseraniye ba sogokuruza ririko n’indahiro, nk’uko biri uno musi.
Ariko ndababwije ukuri ko nimwava k’ Uhoraho mugakurikira izindi mana, mukazisenga, mukazunamira, muzorandurwa.
Nk’uko Uhoraho yaranduye ayandi mahanga imbere yanyu, ni ko namwe muzorandurwa nimutumvira Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Tega amatwi yewe Isirayeli. Ehe mugira mujabuke Yorodani, mwinjire mwongere munyage amahanga maninimanini kandi akomeye kubarusha, afise ibisagara bininibinini, vy’inzitiro zikora kw’ijuru.
Ababibamwo barakomeye kandi ni barebare, ni bo Banaki. Murazi ivyabo kuko mwarumvise havugwa ngo: “Ni nde yohagarara imbere y’Abanaki?”

Ariko mumenye neza ko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari we azoja imbere yanyu mu kujabuka, abitangire imbere ameze nk’umuriro utongora. Azobahonya; abamare inkomezi imbere yanyu; namwe muheze mubatere mubirukane nk’uko Uhoraho yabibasezeraniye.

Uhoraho Imana yanyu niyamara kwirukana ayo mahanga imbere yanyu, ntimuzokwibwire mu mitima yanyu muti: “ Uhoraho yatuzanye gufata kino gihugu kuko turi abagororotsi.” Haba na gatoya. Ni ububi bw’ayo mahanga butumye Uhoraho ayirukana imbere yanyu.

Si kubera ubugororotsi bwanyu canke ubwizigirwa bwanyu mugiye kwinjira ico gihugu mukacegukira, ni ububi bwayo buzotuma Uhoraho Imana yanyu abirukana, kugira ashitse ivyo yarahiye ba sogokuruza bacu Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo.
Nuko rero mutahure neza ko atari kubera ukugororoka kwanyu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye iki gihugu ngo mucegukire, ahubwo mwibuke ko muri abantu b’intagondwa.
Muzokwame muvyibuka, kandi ntimuze mwigere mwibagira ingene mwashavuje Uhoraho Imana yanyu muri mu bugaragwa. Kuva igihe mwava muri Egiputa gushika n’ubu mwamye mugarariza Uhoraho .
Ku musozi Horebu mwashavuje Uhoraho ahakwa kubatikiza.
Igihe naduga ku musozi gutora ibisate vy’amabuye, ibisate vy’isezerano Uhoraho yagiranye namwe, namaze ku musozi imisi mirongo ine n’amajoro mirongo ine nyene, ntarya, ntanywa.
Uhoraho ampa ibisate bibiri vy’amabuye vyandikishijweko n’urutoke rw’Imana. Kuri vyo hariko amabwirizwa Uhoraho yabahereye ku musozi ari mu muriro, ku musi mwari mwakoranye.
Imisi mirongo ine n’amajoro mirongo ine biheze, Uhoraho yampaye ivyo bisate bibiri vy’amabuye, ari vyo bisate vy’isezerano.
Ni ho Uhoraho yambarira ati: “Ihute umanuke, kuko ba bantu bawe wakura muri Egiputa bononekaye. Bamaze kuva mu nzira nabategetse kugenderamwo, bicuriye ikigirwamana.”
Maze Uhoraho arambarira ati: “Niboneye aba bantu ingene ari intagondwa.
None rero mbisa, kugira ngo ndabarandure n’izina ryabo ndarizimanganye musi y’ijuru. Nawe nzoheza ndakugire ihanga rikomeye, rinini gusumba bo.”
Ni ho nahindukira nkamanuka, nkava kuri uwo musozi waka umuriro. Nawumanutse mfise mu minwe ivyo bisate vy’amabuye vy’isezerano.
Ndavye mbona mwacumuye k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mwicuriye ikigirwamana mw’ishusho y’ishuri. Mwari mwamaze kuva mu nzira Uhoraho yaberetse.
Nca mfata vya bisate vy’amabuye ndabikubita hasi, biramenagurika bicika ubunywenywe imbere y’amaso yanyu.

Ariko nsubira kuja kwikubita imbere y’ Uhoraho , mara iyindi misi mirongo ine n’amajoro mirongo ine ata co ndya, ata co nywa, kubera ivyaha mwari mwakoze, mu gukora ibitabereye mu nyonga z’Imana, mukayitera kuraka.
Natinye ishavu n’uburake vy’ Uhoraho , kuko yari abarakiye bikomeye agira abarandure. Ariko arasubira aranyumvira.
Uhoraho yari yarakariye bikomeye na Aroni agira amurandure, ariko na we nyene muri ico gihe ndamusabira, aramubabarira.
Hanyuma mfata ca kimenyetso c’icaha canyu ari yo ya shuri mwacuze, ndagiturira, mpejeje ndagisya, gicika ifu kimera nk’umukungugu, ndawusuka mu mugende w’amazi utemba uva ku musozi.
Uhoraho mwarasubiriye muramushavuza i Tabera, i Masa n’i Kiburoti Hatava.

Kandi igihe Uhoraho yabarungika muva i Kadeshi Baruneya yavuze ati: “Nimuduge mufate igihugu ndabahaye ngo kibe icanyu.” Ariko mugarariza amabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Ntimwamwizeye canke ngo mumwumvire.
Mwamye mugarariza Uhoraho kuva igihe nabamenya.
Napfukamiye Uhoraho ndamutakambira muri iyo misi mirongo ine n’amajoro mirongo ine, kuko Uhoraho yari yamaze gufata ingingo yo kubarandura.
Nasenze Uhoraho mvuga nti: “ Uhoraho Nyeninganji, nturandure abantu bawe, ubwoko wiharije, abo wacunguje ububasha bwawe ukabakuza muri Egiputa ukuboko kwawe kw’inkomezi.
Niwibuke abasavyi bawe Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo, maze wirengagize ubugarariji bw’ubu bwoko, wirengagize ibibi n’ivyaha vyabo.
Niwabarandura, Abanyegiputa bazovuga bati: ‘ Uhoraho vyaramunaniye gushikana abantu biwe mu gihugu yabasezeraniye, kandi kubera abanka, yabakuye ino kugira ngo aje kubatikiriza mu bugaragwa.’
Ariko ni abantu bawe, ni inyegu yawe wakuje muri Egiputa ububasha bwawe n’ukuboko kwawe kw’inkomezi.”

headings.text: Icatumye Imana yirukana amahanga imbere y’Abisirayeli
Bibutswa ivyerekeye ishuri yakozwe mu nzahabu

verses.text: Ico gihe Uhoraho yarambariye ati: “Ibazire ibindi bisate bibiri vy’amabuye bimeze nka bimwe vya mbere, ubaze n’isandugu mu mbaho yo kubibikamwo, uheze uduge ku musozi aho ndi.
Nzokwandikira kuri ivyo bisate amajambo yari kuri bimwe wamena, uheze ubibike muri iyo sandugu.”
Nuko nca mbaza isandugu mu giti c’ikasiya, mbaza n’ibisate vy’amabuye bibiri bimeze nka bimwe vya mbere, nca nduga ku musozi ntwaye vya bisate bibiri mu minwe.
Uhoraho yandika kuri ivyo bisate ivyo yari yanditse ku vya mbere, ari yo mabwirizwa icumi yari yababwiriye ku musozi ari mu muriro, umusi mwari mwakoranye. Ahejeje, arabimpa.
Ni ho nagaruka mvuye kuri uwo musozi, ngashira vya bisate muri ya sandugu nari nabaje nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabintegetse, kandi n’ubu ni yo biri.
Maze Abisirayeli bafata urugendo rwo kuva ku mariba y’ahantu hitwa Bene Yakani, baja i Mosera. Aho ni ho Aroni yapfiriye, bamuhambaho, umuhungu wiwe Eliyazeri aramusubirira nk’umuherezi mukuru.
Bavuye aho bagiye i Gudigoda bashika n’i Yotubata, igihugu kirimwo inzuzi nyinshi.

Ico gihe Uhoraho yatoranije umuryango wa Lewi ngo abe ari wo urerura Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho , bagahagarara imbere y’ Uhoraho , bagakora igikorwa c’ubuherezi, bakongera bagahezagira abantu mw’izina ryiwe, nk’uko babikora n’ubu.
Ni co gituma Abalewi ata co batoranye muri benewabo, kuko Uhoraho ari we mugabane wabo, nk’uko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabibabwiye.
Jewe rero nagumye imbere y’ Uhoraho imisi mirongo ine n’amajoro mirongo ine, nk’uko nari nabigenjeje ubwa mbere, ico gihe na ho nyene Uhoraho aranyumvira, yemera kutabarandura.
Uhoraho arambarira ati: “Genda urongore abantu bafate urugendo, binjire igihugu nasezeraniye ba sogokuruza ko nzokibaha, kibe icabo.”
None rero Bisirayeli, mbega ico Uhoraho Imana yanyu abagombako si ukumwubaha no kugendera mu nzira ziwe zose, mukamukunda, mukamukorera n’imitima yanyu yose, n’imishaha yanyu yose,
no gukurikiza amabwirizwa n’amategeko y’ Uhoraho ndabahaye uwu musi, ku bw’ineza yanyu?
Ijuru ndetse n’amajuru yo hejuru cane hamwe n’isi n’ibiri muri yo vyose ni ivy’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ariko Uhoraho yerekanye umutima w’urukundo kuri ba sogokuruza banyu, arabakunda, hanyuma atoranya mwebwe uruvyaro rwabo, abarutisha ayandi mahanga yose nk’uko biri uno musi.
Nuko rero nimukebwe mu mitima yanyu, muve mu bugarariji.
Kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari Imana isumba ivyitwa imana vyose, akaba Umwami w’abami, Imana ihambaye, ikomeye kandi y’igitangaza, idahengamira kuri nkunzi kandi idahabwa igiturire.
Iburanira impfuvyi n’abapfakazi, ikunda abanyamahanga baba hagati muri mwebwe, ikabagaburira, ikabambika.
None rero namwe mukunde abanyamahanga bari muri mwebwe, kuko namwe mwigeze kuba abanyamahanga muri Egiputa.
Mutinye Uhoraho Imana yanyu, bifatanije no kumwubaha, kandi mumukorere. Mwifatanye na we, indahiro yanyu ibe izina ryiwe.
Ni yo Mana yanyu, ni yo yonyene ikwiye gushimwa, iyakoze ibitangaza biteye ubwoba nk’ivyo mwiboneye n’amaso yanyu.
Ba sogokuruza banyu bamanutse muri Egiputa bari mirongo indwi bose hamwe, ariko raba ubu Uhoraho Imana yanyu yarabagwijije mungana n’inyeyeri zo kw’ijuru.

headings.text: Bongera kubwirwa gutinya Uhoraho no kumwumvira

verses.text: Mukunde Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mukurikize ivyo ababwiye, amategeko, amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe vyiwe.
Uno musi, mwibuke ko atari abana banyu babonye kandi baronse indero y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu ikoresheje icubahiro cayo, ukuboko kwayo kw’ubushobozi kandi kuramvuye;
si bo babonye ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza yakoreye hagati muri Egiputa, kuri Farawo umwami no ku gihugu ciwe cose ca Egiputa;
ivyo Uhoraho yakoreye ingabo zose za Egiputa, amafarasi n’imikogote vyabo, ingene yabisutse mu Kiyaga Gitukura, igihe bariko barabakurikira, n’ingene yabagesheje ubutakivayo.
Si abana banyu babonye ivyo Uhoraho yabakoreye kuva igihe mwari mu bugaragwa kugeza mushitse muri iki kibanza,

si bo babonye ivyo yakoreye Datani na Abiramu, bene Eliyabu wo mu muryango wa Reyubeni, igihe isi yasama hagati mu Bisirayeli ikabamirana n’abo mu nzu zabo bose, amahema yabo n’ikintu cabo cose gihumeka.
Ariko, amaso yanyu ni yo yiboneye ivyo bitangaza vyose Uhoraho yakoze.
None rero mwirinde, kugira ngo muzokurikize amabwirizwa ndabahaye uwu musi, kugira ngo muronke inkomezi zo kujabuka Yorodani no kwinjira muri ico gihugu mukagifata,
kugira ngo muzoshobore kurambira muri ico gihugu Uhoraho yarahiye ba sogokuruza ko azokibaha hamwe n’uruvyaro rwabo, igihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki.
Igihugu mugiye kwinjiramwo mukacegukira ntikimeze nka Egiputa mwahoramwo, aho mwaruha muvomera ibiterwa vyose nk’uwuvomera imboga.
Ariko igihugu mugiye kwinjiramwo mukacegukira ni igihugu c’imisozi n’ibiyaya kivomererwa n’imvura.
Ni igihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu we nyene yitaho, inyonga ziwe zama kuri co kuva ku ntango y’umwaka gushika mu mpera yawo.
Rero nimwumvira mugakurikiza ivyo amabwirizwa ndabahaye uwu musi avuga, ni ukuvuga gukunda Uhoraho Imana yanyu no kumukorera n’imitima yanyu yose n’imishaha yanyu yose,
na we, azorungika imvura mu gihe cayo, iy’agatasi n’iy’impeshi, kugira ngo mushobore kwimbura ingano, imivinyu n’amavuta ya elayo.
Azotanga ubwatsi mu buragiro bw’ibitungwa vyanyu, kandi namwe muzoronka ivyo murya muhage.
Ariko rero mwirinde, mwoye guhendwa mu mitima yanyu ngo muve k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mukorere izindi mana mwongere muzisenge.

Nimwabikora, uburake bw’Imana buzoziriringa kuri mwebwe, hanyuma azokwugara ijuru ntiribe rigitanga imvura, kandi isi ntizoba ikimera ibiterwa. Namwe muzotikirira muri ico gihugu ciza cane Uhoraho abahaye.
Aya majambo yanje muyashire mu mitima yanyu no mu bwenge bwanyu, muyabohere ku maboko no mu ruhanga nk’ivyibutso.
Muzoyigishe abana banyu, muyaganireko iyo mwicaye i muhira n’iyo muri ku rugendo, iyo mugiye kuryama n’iyo muvyutse.
Muzovyandike ku bishimaryango vy’amazu yanyu, no ku nzugi z’amarembo yanyu,
kugira ngo mwe n’abana banyu muzorambire muri ico gihugu, Uhoraho yarahiye ba sogokuruza ko azokibaha, gushika igihe ijuru rizoba rikiri hejuru y’isi.
Nimwakurikiza neza amabwirizwa mbahaye uno musi, ari yo gukunda Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kugendera mu nzira ziwe zose no kwifatanya na we,
Uhoraho na we azokwirukana ayo mahanga yose imbere yanyu, naho ari maninimanini cane, akomeye cane kubarusha, kandi muzoyigarurira.
Aho muzohonyoza ikirenge hose hazoba bahaye ahanyu. Imbibe zanyu zizova ku bugaragwa bw’i Libani, no ku ruzi Efurate zishike ku Kiyaga Mediterane co mu burengero.
Nta muntu n’umwe azoshobora kubahagarara imbere ngo abagwanye, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu azogwisha abantu igihumura kubera mwebwe, aho muzoja hose, nk’uko Uhoraho yabibasezeraniye.
Ehe raba uwu musi mbashize imbere imigisha n’imivumo,
imihezagiro mu gihe mwemeye kwumvira aya mabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ayo ndabahaye uno musi,
imivumo nimwanka kwumvira aya mabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mukava mu nzira yabategetse kugenderamwo, mugasenga izindi mana mutari bwabone.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu niyabashikana muri ico gihugu mukagifata, muzokwaturire imigisha ku musozi Gerizimu, imivumo na yo muzoyivugire ku musozi Ebalu.
Iyo misozi yose iri hakurya ya Yorodani, mu ntara y’Abanyakanani, amaja mu burengero, hafi y’ibiti vya More, mu ntara y’Abanyakanani baba muri Araba hafi y’igisagara ca Gilugali.
Ehe mugira mujabuke Yorodani mufate igihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye.
Nimwagishikamwo mukakibamwo, muzoshire imitima yanyu ku gukurikiza amategeko n’ivyagezwe ndabahaye uwu musi.
Aya ni yo mabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe mutegerezwa kwitwararika gukurikiza igihe cose muzoba mukiba muri kino gihugu Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza abahaye ngo mucegukire.
Muzosangangure ibibanza vyose vyo ku misozi, ku mitumba no musi y’ibiti, aho abanyamahanga muzokwirukana bahora basengera imana zabo.
Muzomenagure ibicaniro vyabo, mumenagure n’amabuye yabo, muturire n’inkingi za Ashera, musatagure n’ibishusho vy’imana zabo, muzimanganye n’amazina y’imana zabo muri ivyo bibanza.
Ntimuze musenge Uhoraho Imana yanyu nk’uko basenga imana zabo.
Ariko muzorondere ikibanza Uhoraho Imana yanyu azokwitoraniriza mu miryango yanyu, ikibanza izina ryayo rizokwambarizwamwo.

Abe ari ho muzoja, mujanye amashikanwa yo guturirwa hamwe n’ibimazi, ibigiracumi n’amashikanwa adasanzwe, ivyo mwasezeranye gushikanira Imana n’ivyo mutanze mwishakiye, hamwe n’imfura z’ibitungwa n’imikuku vyanyu.
Aho hantu, muri kumwe n’imiryango yanyu kandi muri imbere y’ Uhoraho , aze abe ari ho muzohora murira mwongera munezerererwa ibintu vyose mwaronse kubera Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabahezagiye.
Ntimuzobikore nk’uko tubikora ngaha, kuko ngaha umwe wese abikora uko yumva bibereye kuri we,
kubera yuko mutarashika mu gihugu c’uburuhukiro, igihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye nk’iragi.
Ariko muzojabuka Yorodani mube mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye nk’iragi, kandi izobaha kuruhuka intambara mwaterwa n’abansi banyu babakikije hanyuma mwibere mu mutekano.

Mu kibanza Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yitoreye ngo ahashire Izina ryiwe, azobe ari ho muzomushikanira ibi ndababwiye vyose: amashikanwa yo guturirwa, hamwe n’ibimazi, ibigiracumi n’amashikanwa adasanzwe, hamwe n’ivyo mwasezeranye gushikanira Uhoraho .

Hanyuma muri ngaho, muze munezererwe kuba imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mwebwe, abahungu banyu n’abakobwa banyu, abakozi b’abahungu n’abakobwa hamwe rero n’Abalewi baba mu bisagara vyanyu kuko ata matongo canke ibisagara batoranye.
Muze mwirinde ntimushikanire amashikanwa yo guturirwa aho mwishakiye.
Muzoyashikanire mu kibanza Uhoraho azotoranya mu muryango umwe mu miryango yanyu.

Ariko murashobora kuzobagira ibitungwa vyanyu mu bisagara vyanyu, mukarya inyama uko muvyipfuza, ari nk’ingeregere canke impongo, mukurikije uko Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yabahezagiye. Abasanzwe bahumanye n’abadahumanye bose bashobora kuziryako.
Ariko amaraso yavyo ntimuzoyarye, muzoyasese hasi nk’amazi.

Ntimuzorire mu bisagara vyanyu ibigiracumi vy’ingano n’umuvinyu mushasha hamwe n’amavuta ya Elayo, canke imfura z’ibitungwa n’iz’imikuku vyanyu, canke ikindi kintu cose mwasezeranye gutanga caba ico mutanze mwishakiye canke ayandi mashikanwa adasanzwe.

Ahubwo muzobirire imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mu kibanza azoba yitoranirije. Muzobisangire n’abana banyu, abahungu n’abakobwa, abakozi banyu b’abahungu n’abakobwa hamwe n’Abalewi baba mu bisagara vyanyu, kandi muzonezererwe imbere y’ Uhoraho mu vyo muzoba mwaronse.
Muzokwiyubare ntimufate minenerwe Abalewi bazoba bari muri mwebwe igihe cose muzoba mukiba muri ico gihugu.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu niyamara kwagura intara zanyu nk’uko yabibasezeraniye, hanyuma mukipfuza kurya inyama, mukavuga muti: “Ndipfuza inyama” muzorye izo mushaka zose.

Hamwe na ho ikibanza Uhoraho Imana yanyu azokwihitiramwo ngo citirirwe Izina ryiwe kibaye kure yanyu, muzobage ibitungwa vyanyu Uhoraho yabahaye, nk’uko nabibabwiye, mubibagire mu bisagara vyanyu, murye ivyo mwipfuza vyose.
Muzobirye nk’uko mworya ingeregere canke impongo. Kandi bose abahumanye n’abadahumanye barashobora kuziryako.
Ariko muzokwirinde ntimurye amaraso, kuko amaraso ari bwo buzima, rero ntimuzorye ubuzima hamwe n’inyama.
Ntimuzorye amaraso, ariko muzoyasese hasi nk’amazi.
Ntimuzoyarye, kugira ngo ivyanyu, mwe n’uruvyaro rwanyu ruzokwaruka inyuma bize bigende neza, kuko muzoba mukoze ibigororotse mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho .
Ariko muzofate amashikanwa yejejwe, ayo mwasezeranye gushikana, muheze nuyatware mu kibanza Uhoraho azoba yahisemwo.
Muzoshikane ku gicaniro amashikanwa yanyu yo guturirwa, inyama hamwe n’amaraso. Amaraso y’ibimazi vyanyu muzoyasuke i ruhande y’igicaniro c’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ariko inyama muzozirye.

Mwiyubare kugira ngo muze mwumvire aya mategeko ndabahaye yose, kugira ngo ivyanyu, mwe n’abana banyu bazokwaruka inyuma yanyu, bizokwame bigenda neza, kuko muzoba muriko murakora ibigororotse mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu azotikiza imbere yanyu amahanga mugiye gutera no kunyaga igihugu. Ariko nimwamara kubirukana mukaba mu gihugu cabo,

kandi bamaze kurandurwa imbere yanyu muze mwiyubare ntimuzogwe mu mutego wo kurondera kumenya ivyerekeye imana zabo, mukavuga muti: “Mbega aya mahanga yasenga imana zabo gute? Dushaka gusenga nka bo.”

Ntimuzosenge Uhoraho Imana yanyu nk’uko basenga imana zabo, kuko mu gusenga kwabo bakora ibizira vy’ubwoko bwose Uhoraho yanka. Mbere baratanga abahungu n’abakobwa babo kugira ngo baturirwe kw’ibimazi vy’ishikanwa bashikaniye imana zabo.
Mube maso, mukurikize ivyo ndababwiye vyose, ntihagire ico mwongerako canke ngo hagire ico mukurako.
Nihagira umuvugishwa canke umuntu asobanura indoto ahaguruka muri mwebwe akababwira ibizoba, agatanga ibimenyetso canke ibitangaza,
hanyuma vya bitangaza bishitse akababwira ati: “Nimuze dukurikire izindi mana tuzikorere,” ababwira imana mutari muzi,
ntimuzokwumvirize amajambo y’uwo muvugishwa canke uwo murosi. Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba ariko arabagerageza ngo arabe ko mumukunda n’imitima yanyu yose, n’imishaha yanyu yose.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu ni we wenyene wo gukurikira, kandi ni we wo gutinywa bifatanije no kwubahwa. Mukurikize amabwirizwa yiwe, mwongere mumwubahe, mumukorere, mwongere mumwumireko.

Uwo muvugishwa canke uwo murosi azokwicwe, kuko azoba ariko arabigisha kugarariza Uhoraho Imana yanyu, yabakuye muri Egiputa, abarokoye mu buja. Kuko bazoba bariko barabakura mu nzira z’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, muzobice, ni ho muzoba mukuye ikibi muri mwebwe.
Nihagira mwenewanyu, umuhungu wawe canke umukobwa wawe, umugore wawe ukunda cane, canke umugenzi wawe, akwongorera ati: “Ingo tuje gusenga izindi mana,” imana mwe na ba sogokuruza mutari bwabone,
imana z’amahanga abakikuje, zaba iza kure canke iza hafi, zaba izo mu ntara iyi canke iriya,
ntimuzomwumvirize. Ntimuzomugirire impuhwe, ntazobure kwicwa, ntihazogire uwumukingira.
Ntaze abure kwicwa! Wewe yongoreye uzobe uwa mbere kumukubita, hanyuma abandi na bo bazokwifatanye na we mu kumwica.
Muzomwicishe amabuye, kuko yagomba kubakura mu nzira y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabakuye muri Egiputa, mu gihugu c’ubuja.
Maze Abisirayeli bose bazovyumva batinye, nta n’umwe wo muri mwebwe azosubira gukora ibintu nk’ivyo.
Nimwamara kuba mu gisagara kimwe mu bisagara Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye,
mukumva ko hari umunyakibi yahagurutse mu gisagara, akosha abandi avuga ati: “Ingo tuje gusenga izindi mana,” imana mutari muzi,
muzotohoze neza mwitonze. Nimwasanga ivyo bamuvugako ari vyo, mugasanga yakoze ikizira nk’ico muri mwebwe,
ico gisagara muzogitere, mukiririkishe inkota, murandure abakibamwo bose, mumare n’ibitungwa vyaho.

Muzokwegeranye ivyo mwanyaze vyose mubishire ku kibuga muheze mubiturirane n’igisagara cose, maze bibe nk’ikimazi gituririwe Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Kizokwame ari umusaka, ntikizokwigere gisubira kwubakwa.
Ntihaze hagire na kimwe mu vyagenewe guturirwa mwisigariza, kugira ngo Uhoraho asubize hasi uburake bwiwe, abagirire imbabazi, abagirire impuhwe yongere abagwize, nk’uko yabirahiye ba sogokuruza.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobagirira impuhwe nimwamwumvira mugakurikiza amabwirizwa yiwe ndabahaye uno musi, mugakora ibimuhimbara.
Muri abana b’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Nimwagandarira uwapfuye, ntimuzokwimoshe umushatsi wo mu ruhanga,
kuko muri ubwoko bwatoranijwe n’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Mu yandi mahanga yose yo kw’isi, Uhoraho yatoranije mwebwe ngo mube ubutunzi bwiwe.
None rero ntimuzorye ikintu na kimwe kizira.
Ibi ni vyo bikoko mwemerewe kurya: inka, intama, impene,
impongo, ingeregere, ifumberi, impene y’inyeshamba, inzobe, imbogo, hamwe n’intama y’inyeshamba.
Muremerewe kandi kurya igikoko cose gifise ikinono gisatuye kandi cuza ivyo cariye;
ariko ibidafise ibinono bisatuye kandi bituza, ntimuzobirye. None rero ntimuze murye ingamiya, agakwavu, canke inkezi, naho vyuza, ibinono vyavyo ntibisatuye; ivyo birahumanye kuri mwebwe.
Ingurube na yo nyene irahumanye, kuko naho ifise ibinono bisatuye, ntiyuza. Ntimuzorye inyama zavyo, ntimuzokore no ku mivyimba yavyo.
Mu biba mu mazi vyose, mwemerewe kurya ibifise amababa n’ibigaragamba.
Ibidafise amababa n’ibigaragamba ntimuze mubirye, birahumanye kuri mwebwe.
Murashobora kurya ibiguruka vyose bidahumanye.
Ariko ibi bikurikira ntimuzobirye: inkona, ikinyakabaka, inkukuma,
ikinyamwanira, icaruzanyoni nk’uko amoko yavyo ari,
ubwoko bwose bw’ibikona,
ikigendabunyovu, sarumfune, inguriguri, n’amoko yose y’ubuca;
igihuna, ikirovyi, inyanana,
ikinyamwanira, inkongori, ikiryamivyimba,
agasoza, ubwoko bwose bw’inyange, samunsure, n’agahungarema.
Udukoko twose dufise amababa tukagendera ku maguru ane, turahumanye kuri mwebwe, ntimuze muturye.
Ariko ibindi bikoko vyose bifise amababa bidahumanye muzobirye.

Ntimuzorye ikintu na kimwe muzosanga capfuye. Muzobihe abanyamahanga bazoba bari muri mwebwe, canke muzokigurishe ku banyamahanga. Ariko mwebwe ntimuzokirye kuko muri ubwoko bwejejwe kubera Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Ntimuzotekeshe umwagazi w’impene amata ya nyina wayo.
Muzokwame mwegeranya ikigiracumi c’ivyo mwimbuye mu mirima yanyu ku mwaka ku mwaka.

Muzorire ibigiracumi vyanyu vy’ingano, imivinyu misha, n’amavuta ya elayo, hamwe n’imfura z’ibitungwa n’imikuku vyanyu, mubirire imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mu kibanza azokwitoraniriza ngo citirirwe izina ryiwe, kugira ngo mumenye kwama mumutinya bifatanije no kumwubaha ibihe vyose.
Ariko ico kibanza kibaye kure yanyu, hanyuma Uhoraho Imana yanyu akaba yarabahezagiye mutoshobora gushikanayo ibigiracumi vyanyu,
muzokabe ibigiracumi vyanyu n’ifeza, muzijane mu kibanza Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yaratoranije.

Muzokoreshe izo feza mu kugura ivyo mukeneye, ari inka, intama, impene, imivinyu ihiye n’ibindi binyobwa vyose mwipfuza. Mwe n’imiryango yanyu muheze mubirire imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, munezerwe.
Kandi ntimuze mwibagire Abalewi baba mu bisagara vyanyu, kuko ata matongo canke iragi bafise mu bisagara vyabo.
Ku mpera y’umwaka ugira gatatu, muzozane ibigiracumi vy’ivyimburwa vy’uwo mwaka, mubishingure mu bubiko bw’ibisagara vyanyu,

kugira ngo Abalewi, bo badafise ishamvu yabo bwite barazwe, hamwe n’abanyamahanga, impfuvyi n’abapfakazi baba mu bisagara vyanyu baronke ico barya bahage, ni ho Uhoraho Imana yanyu azohezagira ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu.
Uko imyaka indwi irangiye, uze uhebere imyenda abayigufitiye.

Uku ni ko bikwiye kugenda: Uwaguranye mugenziwe w’Umwisirayeli azomuhebere umwenda wiwe. Ntihazogire uwishuza umubanyi wiwe canke incuti yiwe y’Umwisirayeli, kuko igihe c’ Uhoraho co guheberanira imyenda kizoba cageze.
Uzokwishuze abanyamahanga, ariko benewanyu b’Abisirayeli uzobahebere imyenda bagufitiye.
Kandi, ntihaze hagire umukene aba muri mwebwe, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobahezagiza ubutunzi mu gihugu abahaye ngo kibe iragi ryanyu,
nimwumvira ijwi ry’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu rwose, mugakurikiza amabwirizwa yose ndabahaye uno musi.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobahezagira nk’uko yabisezeranye, muzoha ingurane amahanga menshi, ariko mwebwe nta we muzoyisaba. Muzoganza amahanga menshi ariko mwebwe nta hangana na rimwe rizobaganza.
Nimwashika mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abajanyemwo, hanyuma hakagira umukene aba muri mwebwe, ntimuzokomantaze imitima ngo mureke kumusangiza ku vyo muzoba mufise.
Ariko muzopfumbaturure ibiganza, mumugurane ivyo akeneye vyose n’umutima ubikunze kandi mutagoberewe.

Ntihaze hagire ivyiyumviro bibi biba mu mitima yanyu, mwibwira muti: “Umwaka w’indwi, ari wo mwaka wo guheberanira imyenda urageze,” hanyuma ngo mureke kugurana benewanyu bari mu bukene, mukareka kubafasha. Azoririra Uhoraho , na we azobona ko mwakoze icaha.
Muzobagurane n’umutima ubikunze, ni ho Uhoraho Imana yanyu azohezagira ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu.
Hazokwama hariho abakene mu gihugu. Ni co gituma ndababwiye ngo muze mupfumbatururire ibiganza vyanyu benewanyu n’abakene bazoba bari muri mwebwe.
Nihagira Umuheburayo canke Umuheburayokazi yigurisha kuri mwebwe nk’umugurano akabakorera imyaka itandatu, ku mwaka ugira indwi muzomurekure yidegemvye.
Kandi nimwamurekura, ntimuzomurungike iminwe misa.
Muzomutekerere bimwe mu bitungwa vyanyu, ku vyimburwa bivuye ku mbuga zo gukubitirako ingano no ku mivinyu yanyu. Muzomutekerere bivanye n’uko Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yarabahezagiye.
Muze mwibuke ko namwe mwabaye abagurano muri Egiputa, Uhoraho Imana yanyu akabacungura. Ni co gutuma nanje ndabahaye iri bwirizwa uwu musi.
Ariko umugurano wawe niyakubwira ati: “Singomba kuvana nawe,” kuko agukunda wewe n’umuryango wawe, kandi akaba amererewe neza iwawe,
uzofate icuma umutobore ugutwi ahagaze mu muryango w’inzu, hanyuma abe umugurano wawe ubuzima bwiwe bwose. Uzobikore gutyo no ku mugurano w’umukobwa.

Kurekura umugurano wanyu ntuze ubifate nk’amananiza, kuko ibikorwa azoba yagukoreye muri iyo myaka itandatu bizoba bisumba kabiri ivyo umukozi uhemba yogukorera, kandi Uhoraho Imana yawe azohezagira ibikorwa vy’amaboko yawe.
Muzokwegurire Uhoraho Imana yanyu amashuri y’uburiza azovuka ku bitungwa n’imikuku vyanyu. Ntimuze mwigere murimisha ishuri nk’iyo kandi ntimuze mumwe impfizi z’intama zanyu.
Uko umwaka utashe umuntu wese hamwe n’umuryango wiwe muzoje murayarira imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mu kibanza azoba yaratoranije.
Hamwe igitungwa coba gifise agasembwa, gihumye canke gicumbagira, ntimuzogitangeko ikimazi c’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ahubwo muzokirire mu bisagara vyanyu, abahumanye n’abadahumanye barashobora kukirya, nk’aho yoba ari ingeregere canke impongo.
Ariko ntimuze murye amaraso yaco. Amaraso yaco muzoyasese nk’amazi.
Mu kwezi kwa Abibu, muzohore muhimbaza Pasika y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kuko muri ukwo kwezi kwa Abibu ari ho Uhoraho yabakuye muri Egiputa, hakiri mw’ijoro.
Muzoshikanire ibimazi vya Pasika Uhoraho Imana yanyu mukuye mu bitungwa no mu mikuku vyanyu, mubimushikanire muri ca kibanza Uhoraho azoba yaratoranije ngo habe Izina ryiwe.

Ntimuzorye imikate irimwo umwambiro, ariko muzomare imisi indwi murya imikate itarimwo umwambiro, ni yo mikate y’imibabaro, kuko mwavuye muri Egiputa mwihuta, kugira ngo mu buzima bwanyu muzokwame mwibuka igihe mwaviriye muri Egiputa.
Ntihaze hagire umwambiro uba mu vyo mutunze mu gihugu canyu muri iyo misi ndwi. Ntihaze hagire inyama z’ibimazi vyanyu zirara ngo zishike mu gitondo.
Ntimuze mupfe igisagara mushikaniyemwo ibimazi vya Pasika mu bisagara Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabahaye,
kiretse muri ca kibanza Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yaritoranirije ngo habe izina ryiwe. Aho ni ho muzoshikanira ibimazi vya Pasika ku mugoroba, izuba rirenze, mwibuka umusi mwaviriyeko muri Egiputa.
Muze muteke inyama z’ico gitungwa muzirire muri ico kibanza Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yaratoranije, bukeye muheze musubire mu mahema yanyu.
Muzomare imisi itandatu murya imikate itarimwo umwambiro, ku musi ugira indwi na ho muzogire ikoraniro imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kandi ntimuze mugire igikorwa muwukorako.
Muzoharure amayinga indwi uhereye ku musi mwatanguriyeko kugenya ingano mukoresheje urukero mu gihe co kwimbura,
muheze muhimbaze umusi mukuru w’amayinga mu guha icubahiro Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mumushikanire amashikanwa avuye ku mitima ikunze kubera imigisha azoba yarabahaye.

Muzoheze munezerererwe imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu muri muri ca kibanza azoba yaratoranije kugira habe Izina ryiwe, mwe n’abana banyu, abakozi banyu b’abahungu n’abakobwa, Abalewi bazoba baba muri mwebwe, abanyamahanga, n’impfuvyi n’abapfakazi bazoba bari muri mwebwe.
Muzokwame mwibuka ko mwabaye abagurano muri Egiputa, maze muheze mukurikize neza aya mategeko yose.
Muze mwame muhimbaza imisi mikuru y’insago, mumare imisi indwi muyihimbaza, mumaze kwegeranya ivyimburwa ku bivuye ku mbuga zo gukubitirako ingano no ku mivinyu yanyu.
Muzonezerererwe iyo misi mikuru, mwe n’abana banyu, abakozi banyu b’abahungu n’abakobwa, Abalewi, abanyamahanga, impfuvyi n’abapfakazi bazoba baba mu bisagara vyanyu.

Muze mumare imisi indwi muhimbaza iyo misi mikuru mwibuka Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mumuhimbariza mu kibanza Uhoraho azoba yitoranirije. Kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yabahezagiriye indimiro zanyu, agahezagira n’ibikorwa vyose vy’amaboko yanyu.

Abagabo bose bo muri mwebwe bazoze imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu gatatu ku mwaka, mu kibanza Uhoraho azoba yaratoranije. Aho na ho hazoba ari ku musi mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro, mu misi mikuru y’amayinga, no mu misi mikuru y’insago. Ntihaze hagire umuntu azoja imbere y’ Uhoraho ata co atwaye.
Umwe wese azogende atwaye ishikanwa rihwanye n’uko Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yaramuhezagiye.
Muze mutore abacamanza n’abatware mu miryango yose no mu bisagara vyose Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye, baze bacire abantu imanza zibereye.
Ntimuze muce izigoramye canke ngo mugire nkunzi. Ntimuzorye ibiturire, kuko bihuma amaso abanyabwenge, bikagoramika amajambo y’intungane.
Muze mukurikire kugira ubutungane, kandi ubutungane bw’ukuri, kugira ngo mubone kubaho no kwegukira igihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye.
Ntihaze hagire inkingi n’imwe ya Ashera muzoshinga i ruhande y’aho muzoba mwubatse igicaniro c’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mushinge n’amabuye, kuko ivyo ari igisesema k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mushikanire Uhoraho Imana yanyu inka canke intama igwaye canke ifise agasembwa, ni ikizira kuri we.
Nihagira umugabo canke umugore muri mwebwe wo mu gisagara na kimwe mu vyo Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yarabahaye muzosanga ariko akora ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, arenga kw’isezerano,
akarenga ku mabwirizwa yanje, agasenga izindi mana, akazunamira canke akunamira izuba, ukwezi canke inyenyeri zo mu kirere,
mukamwumva muze mutohoze neza. Nimwasanga koko ico kizira carakozwe mu Bisirayeli,
muzofate uwo mugore canke uwo mugabo yabikoze mumutware kw’irembo ry’igisagara canyu, mumwicishe amabuye.
Azokwicwe habanje kuboneka ivyabona bibiri canke bitatu, ariko ntihazogire uwicwa habajijwe icabona kimwe gusa.
Kandi icabona kizobe ari co kibanza kumutera ibuye, abandi na bo bazokurikire. Mutegerezwa gukura ikibi muri mwebwe.
Nihagira imanza zigoye babazanira, zaba iz’ubwicanyi canke ugukomeretsanya, muzozitware muri ca kibanza Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yaratoranije.
Muzozishikirize abaherezi ari bo Balewi, canke umucamanza azoba ari ku gikorwa ico gihe. Bazoheza barwumvirize hanyuma baruce.
Muzokurikize ico bazobabwirira mu kibanza Uhoraho azoba yaratoranije. Muze mube maso kugira ngo mukore ico bazobabwira cose.
Muze mukore mukurikije ivyo babigishije vyose n’ivyo bababwiye vyose. Ntimuze muhengamire i buryo canke i bubamfu rw’ivyo bababwiye.
Nihagira uwishira hejuru akanka urubanza umucamanza canke umuherezi azoba ahagaze akorera Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yaciye, aze yicwe. Muzoba mukuye ikibi mu Bisirayeli.
Abantu bose bazovyumva batinye, maze birinde kwishira hejuru.
Nimwashika mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye, mukagifata kikaba icanyu, mukakibamwo, hanyuma mukiyumvira muti: “Reka twiyimikire umwami natwe nk’ayandi mahanga adukikuje,”
muze mube maso kugira ngo mwimike uwo Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yabahitiyemwo. Azobe umwe muri benewanyu b’Abisirayeli. Ntimuze mwimike umunyamahanga, atari Umwisirayeli.
Uwo mwami ntaze atunge ifarasi nyinshi canke ngo arungike abantu muri Egiputa kuzironderayo, kuko Uhoraho yababwiye ati: “Ntimuze mwigere musubira gufata inzira ija muri Egiputa.”
Ntaze agire abagore benshi, kuko umutima wiwe wohava uta inzira ukava k’ Uhoraho . Ntazokwirundanirize inzahabu n’ifeza.
Niyamara gufata intebe y’ubwami, azokwiyandikishirize ikopi y’igitabu c’ibi Vyagezwe, agikuye muri kirya c’abaherezi, ari bo Balewi.
Azocamane kandi azokwame agisoma imisi yose y’ukubaho kwiwe, kugira ngo amenye ingene yubaha Uhoraho Imana yiwe, n’ingene yokurikiza amajambo y’Ivyagezwe n’amategeko ari muri co.
Bizomufasha kwirinda kwifata nk’aho asumba benewabo, canke guhengamira i buryo canke i bubamfu ngo ave muri ya mategeko. Ni ho we n’uruvyaro rwiwe bazorambira ku ngoma muri Isirayeli.

Abaherezi, ari bo Balewi, mbere umuryango wa Lewi wose, nta matongo canke iragi bazoronka muri Isirayeli. Bazobeshwaho n’amashikanwa y’ibifungurwa azokwama ashikanirwa Uhoraho ku gicaniro, uwo ni wo uzoba umugabane wabo.
Nta mugabane bazoronka muri benewabo. Uhoraho ni we mugabane wabo, nk’uko yabibasezeraniye.
Uwu ni wo mugabane abaherezi bazoronka ku bimazi vy’inka, impene n’intama abantu bazoshikana: igikanu, imisaya, n’izo mu nda.
Muzobahe ku vyeze vya mbere vy’ingano, imivinyu mishasha, n’amavuta ya Elayo hamwe n’ubwoya bwa mbere bw’intama,
kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabatoranije hamwe n’uruvyaro rwabo rwose mu yindi miryango yose kugira ngo bakorere izina ryiwe ibihe vyose.
Nihagira Umulewi ava mu gisagara kimwe mu bisagara vyanyu ico ari co cose muri Isirayeli, akaja muri ca kibanza Uhoraho azoba yaratoranije,
azokore igikorwa c’ubuherezi mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe nk’abandi Balewi bazoba bakorera Imana aho.
Bazogabure banganye ivyo baronka ngaho, n’aho yoba asanzwe afise amafaranga yakuye mu vyo umuryango wiwe wagurishije.
Nimwashika mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye, ntimuzokwigane imigenzo isesema y’amahanga y’aho.
Ntihaze hagire uwutanga umwana w’umuhungu canke w’umukobwa ngo aturirwe nk’ikimazi, umuntu aragura canke aroga, uwusobanura kazoza, agakora ivy’ubupfumu,
canke ahamagara ivyago, canke ahamagara imizimu, canke asiguza abapfuye.
Umuntu wese akora ivyo ni igisesema k’ Uhoraho , kandi iyo migenzo y’ibizira ni yo nyene izotuma Uhoraho Imana yanyu yirukana ayo mahanga imbere yanyu.
Mutegerezwa kuba inyankamugayo imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Amahanga mugiye kwirukana, arumviriza abarozi n’abapfumu. Ariko mwebwe Uhoraho Imana yanyu ntabemerera kubikora.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobahagurukiriza umuvugishwa ameze nkanje muri mwebwe, mu Bisirayeli bagenzi banyu, Muzomwumvire,

kuko ico ari co mwasavye Uhoraho Imana yanyu igihe mwari mwakoraniye i Horebu. Mwavuze muti: “Ntidushaka gusubira kwumva ijwi ry’ Uhoraho Imana yacu, canke ngo tubone ikibengebenge c’umuriro, kuko twopfa.”
Uhoraho yambariye ati: “Ivyo bavuze ni vyiza.
Nzohagurutsa umuvugishwa muri mwebwe; nzoshira amajambo yanje mu kanwa kiwe, na we azoshikiriza abantu ivyo nzomutegeka vyose.
Uwutazokwumviriza amajambo yanje uwo muvugishwa azovuga mw’izina ryanje, jewe ubwanje nzobimuharurako.
Ariko uwuzokwigira uwuvugishwa mw’izina ryanje akavuga ivyo ntamutumye, canke hakaza umuvugishwa avugishwa mw’izina ry’izindi mana, azokwicwe.”
Mushobora kwibaza muti: “Mbega tuzomenya gute ko ubuvugishwa kanaka butavuye k’ Uhoraho ?”
Nihagira uwuvugishwa mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ariko ivyo yavugishijwe ntibishike canke ngo bibe ivy’ukuri, ubwo buvugishwa ntibuzoba bwavuye k’ Uhoraho .
Uhoraho Imana yanyu niyarandura amahanga ari mu gihugu abahaye, mukabirukana hanyuma mukaba mu bisagara no mu mazu yabo,
muzotoranye ibisagara bitatu vy’ubuhungiro mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye ngo mucegukire.
Muze murabe neza, ico gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye, mukigaburemwo ibice bitatu, igice cose kibe gifise ico gisagara c’ubuhungiro. Nihagira uwica umuntu azogihungiremwo.
Iri ni ryo tegeko rigenga umuntu yishe uwundi agaca ahungirayo kugira ngo akize amagara yiwe, ni uwishe mugenziwe atabishaka, ata rwanko yahora amufitiye.

Nk’akarorero, umuntu ashobora kuba ari mw’ishamba na mugenziwe kwicira ibiti, hanyuma abanguye incabiti ariko aricira, iyo ncabiti ikaroka igashibuka ikica uwo mugenziwe. Uwo muntu aze ahungire muri kimwe muri ivyo bisagara kugira ngo akize ubugingo bwiwe.

Bitabaye uko, uwuhora amaraso y’uwo yapfuye ashobora kumukurikira yuzuye uburake, agahava amushikira nimba urugendo rwo gushika muri ico gisagara ari rurerure, hanyuma akamwica kandi atari akwiye kwicwa, kuko atishe mugenziwe amufitiye urwanko.
Ni co gituma ndabahaye ibwirizwa ryo kwitoraniriza ibisagara bitatu.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu niyabagurira igihugu nk’uko yabisezeraniye ba sogokuruza ashizeko n’indahiro, akakibaha cose nk’uko yabibasezeraniye,
muze mutoranye ibindi bisagara bitatu vy’ubuhungiro. Azobaha ico gihugu nimwitondera neza amabwirizwa ndabahaye, mugakunda Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mukagendera mu nzira ziwe.
Muzobikore ukwo kugira ngo ntihazogire amaraso asesekera ubusa mu gihugu canyu, ico Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye nk’iragi ryanyu, ni ho mutazoharurwako amaraso azoba yasesetse.
Ariko nihagira umuntu agirira akazikira mugenziwe, hanyuma akamubundira, akamusimbirako akamwica, hanyuma agahungira muri kimwe muri ivyo bisagara,
abatware b’ico gisagara bazomutumeko, bamusubize mu gisagara ciwe, bamushikirize uwuhora amaraso amwice.
Ntimuzomugirire imbabazi. Mutegerezwa gukura uwagirizwa icaha c’ubwicanyi mu Bisirayeli, kugira ngo ivyanyu bizogende neza.
Nimwashika mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye nk’iragi, ntimuze mwigere mwiha itongo ry’uwundi mu kwigiza hirya akarimbi ba sogokuruza banyu bashinze ku matongo yanyu.
Ntihaze hagire uwo muzokwagiriza icaha mwumvirije icabona kimwe gusa. Muzoce urubanza mwumvirije ivyabona bibiri canke bitatu.
Nihagira icabona cagiriza umuntu icaha kibesha,
uwagirizwa n’uwagiriza bazozanwe imbere y’ Uhoraho , imbere y’abaherezi n’abacamanza bakiri mu bikorwa.
Abacamanza bazokore amatohoza neza, basanze ico cabona kibesha, kigatanga ivyemezo bitari vyo mu kwagiriza mwenewabo w’Umwisirayeli,
muzomucire nk’urwo yashaka gucira mwenewabo. Mutegerezwa gukura ikibi muri mwebwe.
Abandi nibavyumva baze batinye, ntihagire uwuzosubira kwubahuka gukora ikibi nk’ico muri mwebwe.
Ntimuzomugirire imbabazi: ubuzima buzohorwe ubundi, ijisho rihorwe irindi, iryinyo rihorwe irindi, ukuboko guhorwe ukundi, ikirenge gihorwe ikindi.
Nimwaja kugwana n’abansi banyu, mukabona bafise imikogote n’amafarasi hamwe n’ingabo zisumba izanyu, ntimuzobatinye. Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabakuye muri Egiputa, izoba iri kumwe namwe.
Nimwitegurira kuja mu ntambara, umuherezi azoze imbere y’ingabo azibwire ijambo.
Azobabarire ati: “Nimunyumvirize yemwe Bisirayeli! Uyu musi mugiye kugwanya abansi banyu. Ntimuranduke imitima canke ngo mutinye. Ntimuzohinde agashitsi imbere yabo.
Kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari we azojana namwe kugwanya abo bansi banyu, akabaha intsinzi.”
Abatware bazobaze ingabo bati: “Mbega hari uwoba yari yubatse inzu ariko akaba atari bwayibemwo? Nabanze asubire inyuma kuko yohava agwa ku rugamba, uwundi akaba ari we ayinjira.
Mbega hari uwoba yari afise umurima w’uruzabibu ariko akaba atari bwatangure kururyako? Nasubire inyuma, kuko yohava agwa ku rugamba, uwundi akaba ari we agwirira.
Mbega hari uwoba yari yakoye umwigeme mugabo akaba atari bwamurongore? Nasubire inyuma arongore umugeni wiwe, kuko yohava agwa ku rugamba hanyuma uwo mugeni akarongorwa n’uwundi.”
Abo batware baze bongereko bati: “Mbega hari uwumva afise ubwoba canke asimbwa n’umutima? Nasubire i muhira kugira ngo ntatume bagenziwe basimbwa n’umutima.”
Abatware nibamara kubabwira ayo majambo bazoce bagena abakuru barongora imigwi y’ingabo.
Nimwegereza igisagara kanaka kugira ngo mugitere, muzobanze gusaba abakibamwo mugiranire isezerano ry’amahoro.
Nibavyemera mu mahoro bakabugururira imiryango y’ibisagara vyabo, abantu baho bose muzobagire abagurano banyu mubakoreshe ibikorwa biruhije.
Naho nibanka ko mugiriranira isezerano ry’amahoro, ico gisagara muzogitere, mugifate.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu niyagishira mu maboko yanyu, muzokwicishe inkota abagabo bo muri co bose.
Ariko abagore, abana, ibitungwa n’ibindi vyose muzosanga muri ico gisagara, muzobigire iminyago yanyu. Ivyo Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yabahaye nk’iminyago muzobikoreshe ico mushaka.
Ariko ivyo muzobigirire ibisagara vyose vya kure, ntimuzobikorere ibisagara vy’amahanga yo mu gihugu mugiye kwinjira.
Mu bisagara vyo mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye nk’iragi ryanyu, ntimuzosigaze igihumeka na kimwe.
Muzobatikize bose: Abaheti, Abamori, Abanyakanani, Abaperizi, Abahiwi n’Abayebusi, nk’uko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabibategetse.
Nimwabareka bakabaho, bazohava babigisha gukora ibizira vyose bakora iyo basenga imana zabo, gutyo mugacumura k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.

Nimwatera igisagara mukacugariza igihe kirekire, ntimuzotikize ibiti vyama ivyamwa muvyiciza incabiti, kuko muzokenera kurya ivyamwa vyavyo. Ntimuzovyicire. Mbega bizoba bibaye abantu ngo muvyugarize?
Ariko ibiti bidatanga ivyamwa muzovyicire, mubikuremwo ibikoresho muzoba mukeneye vyo kwugariza igisagara c’abansi banyu, gushika mukinesheje.
Nimwasanga umuntu yishwe, aryamye hasi mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabahaye nk’iragi, ariko ntimumenye uwamwishe,
abatware n’abacamanza bazogere imetero z’uburebure ziri hagati y’ico kiziga n’igisagara kiri hafi yaco.
Nibamara kubona igisagara kiri hafi yaco, abatware b’ico gisagara bazofate ishashi y’inka itarigera ikoreshwa ibikorwa vyo kurima, canke ngo yambikwe ingogo,
bayimanukane ku mwonga utigeze urimwa ngo uterwemwo ibiterwa, urimwo amazi aguma atemba. Maze iyo shashi baze bayivunire izosi muri uwo mwonga.

Abaherezi, ari bo Balewi, bazoze imbere, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yabatoranije ngo bakore igikorwa c’ubuherezi bongere bahezagire mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho , kandi ni bo bategerezwa guca imanza z’amatati no gukomeretsanya.
Maze abatware b’igisagara kizoba kiri hafi y’ico kiziga bazokarabire ibiganza vyabo kuri iyo shashi bazoba bavuniye izosi kuri uwo mwonga.
Bazovuge bati: “Amaboko yacu ntiyasheshe amaraso y’uwu muntu, kandi ntitwabonye n’ukuntu yishwe.
None rero Uhoraho we, wakire iyi mpongano, ubabarire Abisirayeli wacunguye, ntubaharureko amaraso y’uwu muntu yishwe ata co azira.” Maze ayo maraso y’uwo azoba ahongewe.
Gutyo muzoba mwikuyeko icaha co gusesa amaraso y’umuntu ata co azira, kuko muzoba mwakoze ibibereye mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho .
Nimwaja kugwanya abansi banyu, maze Uhoraho Imana yanyu akabatanga mu maboko yanyu mukabagira imbohe,
hanyuma ugashima umugore umwe mu mbohe zanyu, uzomugire umugore wawe.
Uzomwinjize mu nzu yawe, yimoshe, yice inzara,
hanyuma ahindure impuzu yari yambaye akiri imbohe, yambare izindi. Niyamara kuba mu nzu yawe, akagandarira se na nyina ukwezi kwose, uzoheze umurongore, ube umugabo wiwe na we abe umugore wawe.
Nihagera igihe ntabe akikunezera, uzomureke yigire iyo ashaka. Ntuzomugurishe canke ngo umugire umugurano, kuko wamaze kumutesha agaciro.
Nihagira umugabo agira abagore babiri, hanyuma agakunda umwe kurusha uwundi, bompi bakavyarana na we abahungu, ariko umuhungu wa mbere akaba uw’umugore adakundwa,
hageze ko abagaburira itunga ryiwe, ntazogire samuragwa uwo muhungu w’umugore akundwa, samuragwa azobe uwo kuri uwo mugore adakundwa.
Ategerezwa kwemera ko umuhungu w’umugore adakundwa ari we mfura amuhe imigabane ibiri ku vyo atunze. Uwo muhungu wa mbere ni we kimenyetso c’inkomezi za se. Uburenganzira buhabwa imfura ni ubwiwe.
Abavyeyi nibagira umwana hanyuma akaba umugarariji ntabubahe n’aho bomuhana,
bazomuzane imbere y’abatware kw’irembo ry’igisagara.
Bazobwire abatware b’igisagara bati: “Uwu mwana wacu ni intumva kandi ni umugarariji. Ntatwumvira. Yama mu buhumbu n’akaborerwe.”
Maze abagabo bo muri ico gisagara bose bazomwicishe amabuye. Mutegerezwa gukura ikibi muri mwebwe. Abisirayeli bose bazovyumva batinye.
