Umuntu niyagirizwa agatsindwa n’icaha gituma yicwa, azokwicwe, umuvyimba wiwe bawumanike ku giti,

ariko uwo muvyimba ntuzorare kuri ico giti. Muzomuhambe uwo musi nyene, kuko uwumanitswe ku giti wese azoba ari musi y’umuvumo w’Imana. Gutyo muzoba mwirinze guhumanya igihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye nk’iragi ryanyu.
Niwasanga inka canke intama y’umubanyi iriko irayerera mu gahinga, ntuze uyirengagize, uzoyigarure uyimucurire.
Nyeneyo nataba aba hafi canke ukaba utamumenye, uzoyicure i muhira iwawe uyimubikire gushika aje kuyirondera, nawe uzoheze uyimuhe.
Muze mubikore ukwo no ku ndogoba yazimiye, umutamana wazimiye canke ikindi kintu cose cazimiye. Ntimuze muvyirengagize.
Niwasanga indogoba canke ishuri ya mwenewanyu yaguye ku nzira, ntuze uyirengagize, uze umufashe kuyivyura.
Umugore ntaze yambare ivyambarwa vy’igitsina gabo, kandi n’umugabo ntaze yambare ivyambarwa vy’igitsina gore. Uwukora ivyo aba akoze ikizira k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Nimwasanga icari c’inyoni ku giti, i ruhande y’inzira canke hasi, mugasanga nyina ibundikiriye abana canke amagi, ntimuzotwarane nyina n’abana.
Muzotware abana gusa, nyina muyireke, kugira ngo ivyanyu bizogende neza mukaramba.
Nimwubaka inzu nshasha, muzoyubakire agahome kayizunguruka ko hejuru kuri yo ko gutangira uwokoroka kugira ngo iyo nzu ntizoharurweko icaha co gusesa amaraso hagize uwukoroka avuye hejuru.
Ntimuze mutere ubwoko bubiri bw’imbuto mu ruzabibu rwanyu; nimwabikora, ntimuzoba muhumanije umurima gusa, ariko n’ivyamwa vyarwo na vyo bizoba bihumanye.
Ntimuzorimishe inka isangiye ingogo n’indogoba.
Ntimuzokwambare impuzu zikozwe mu nyuzi z’ubwoko bubiri butandukanye.
Umutamana wo kwipfuka muzowushireko ubushenza ku mitwe ine yawo.
Nihagira umugabo yabira umugore, amaze kuryamana na we akumva aramwanse,
akamumaramaza mu bantu amwagiriza ko yigenjeje nabi, akavuga ati: “Igihe narongora uwu mugore nasanze ata bimenyetso vyerekana ko atigeze aryamana n’umugabo afise,”
abavyeyi b’uwo mugore baze bashire abakuru b’ico gisagara ivyemeza ko uwo mugore atigeze aryamana n’uwundi mugabo.
Se w’uwo mugore azobwire abatware ati: “Uwu mugabo namuhaye umukobwa wanje ngo abe umugore wiwe, ariko ubu aramwanse.

Yamumaramaje avuga ati: ‘Nasanze umukobwa wanyu atagifise ibimenyetso vyerekana ko atigeze aryamana n’uwundi mugabo.’ Ariko ng’ibi ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko umukobwa wacu atigeze aryamana n’uwundi mugabo.” Abo bavyeyi bazokwerekane impuzu yiwe imbere y’abakuru b’igisagara.
Maze abo batware b’igisagara bazoce bafata uwo mugabo bamuhane.
Baze bamucire igihano co gutanga shekeli ijana z’ifeza azihe se w’umugore, kuko yamaramaje umukobwa w’Umwisirayelikazi. Azogume ari umugore wiwe, ntibaze bigere bahukana ubuzima bwabo bwose.
Ariko nibasanga ivyo umugabo avuga ari ukuri, umugore akabura ivyemeza ko yari isugi,

azojanwe ku muryango w’inzu ya se, maze abagabo bose bo muri ico gisagara bazoce bamwicisha amabuye. Azoba yakoze ikizira mu Bisirayeli mu gusambana akiba mu nzu kwa se. Mutegerezwa gukura ikibi muri mwebwe.
Umugabo azofatwa aryamanye n’umugore atari uwiwe, azokwicanwe n’uwo mugore basambanye. Mutegerezwa gukura ikibi muri Isirayeli.
Nihagira umugabo ahurira mu gisagara n’inkumi ikowe, hanyuma agasambana na yo,

muzobatware bose kw’irembo ry’igisagara, mubicishe amabuye. Umugore aze yicwe kuko atakomye induru ngo atabaze kandi yari mu gisagara, umugabo na we aze yicwe kuko yafashe ku nguvu umukobwa w’abandi. Mutegerezwa gukura ikibi muri mwebwe.
Ariko umugabo azohura n’umukobwa akowe n’uwundi ahandi atari mu gisagara akamufata ku nguvu, uwo mugabo azoba yakoze ivyo azokwicwe wenyene.
Uwo mukobwa ntihaze hagire ico mumugira, kuko ata caha azoba yakoze cotuma yicwa. Bizobe nka kurya kw’umuntu yishe mugenziwe ata co amuziza,
kuko uwo mugabo azoba yasanze inkumi mu gahinga akayifata ku nguvu, naho yoba yarakomye induru ntiyashobora kuronka uwumutabara.
Nihagira umugabo ahura n’inkumi idakowe, akayifata ku nguvu hanyuma bagafatwa,

uwo mugabo azohanishwe igihano co gutanga shekeli mirongo itanu z’ifeza azihe se. Hanyuma ategerezwa kumurongora abe umugore wiwe, kuko yamusambanije ku nguvu. Kandi ntaze yigere avana na we igihe cose azoba akiriho.
Ntihazogire umugabo yabira umugore wa se, kuko azoba ahumanije uburiri bwa se.
Umugabo yamenetse amagara canke yaciwe igitsina ntazoje mw’ikoraniro ry’ Uhoraho .
Umuntu yavyawe mu buryo butemewe n’ijambo ry’Imana ntiyemerewe kuja mw’ikoraniro ry’ Uhoraho hamwe n’abamukomokako bose, kugeza ku runganwe rugira icumi.
Nta muntu wo mu Bamoni canke Umunyamowabu, n’uruvyaro rwabo gushika ku runganwe rw’icumi yemerewe kuba mw’ikoraniro ry’ Uhoraho .
Abo bantu ntibabakirije ivyokurya n’amazi igihe mwariko murava muri Egiputa, ariko basavye Balamu mwene Beyori w’i Petori muri Mezopotamiya, ari ho hitwa Aramu-Naharayimu, ngo abavume.
Ariko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ntiyumviye Balamu, umuvumo wiwe awuhindura umuhezagiro wanyu, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu abakunda.
Ntimuzorondere kugirirana amahoro na bo imisi yose yo kubaho kwanyu.
Abanyedomu n’Abanyegiputa ntimuzobafate nk’ikizira, kuko Abanyedomu ari incuti zanyu, kandi mukaba mwarabanye n’Abanyegiputa muri abanyamahanga.
Abo mu runganwe rugira gatatu rwabo bazokwinjire mw’ikoraniro ry’ Uhoraho .
Igihe muzoba muriko muritegurira kuja ku rugamba kugira ngo mutere abansi banyu, muzokure igihumanye cose muri mwebwe.
Umugabo niyahumana biciye mu gusesa imbuto mw’ijoro asinziriye, azoje inyuma y’ikambi amareyo umusi wose.
Bugira buce aze yoge hanyuma izuba rirenze agaruke mw’ikambi.
Muzotegure inyuma y’ikambi ikibanza co kwitumamwo.
Mu bikoresho muzohora mugendana, muzokwibangikanye ikimito. Mugiye kwituma, muzokwimbe akanogo, hanyuma muhejeje mufurire uwo mwanda wanyu.

Kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu agendagenda mu nsago zanyu kugira ngo abakingire yongere arekurire abansi banyu mu maboko yanyu, amakambi yanyu akwiye kuba yejejwe, kugira ngo ntazosangeho ikintu na kimwe giteye isoni, hanyuma akisubirira inyuma.
Umugurano niyaguhungirako avuye mu kindi gihugu kugira ngo umukingire, ntuze umutange kuri shebuja.
Muzobareke babe muri mwebwe, aho bashatse hose no mu gisagara cose bahisemwo. Ntimuzomutwaze umukazo.
Ntihaze hagire Umwisirayeli, yaba umugore canke umugabo, aba maraya mu bibanza basengeramwo ibigirwamana.
Ntimuze mwakire mu nzu y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu amashikanwa yo gushitsa isezerano ashikanywe na maraya, yaba umugore canke umugabo, kuko ayo mashikanwa n’abayashikana vyose ari ibisesema k’ Uhoraho .
Mwenewanyu w’Umwisirayeli, ntimuze mumwake inyungu haba ku mahera canke ku vyokurya canke ku bindi bintu vyose vyari gushobora kubazanira inyungu.
Muzokwake inyungu abanyamahanga, ariko Umwisirayeli ntimuzoyimwake, kugira ngo Uhoraho Imana yanyu azohezagire ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu mu gihugu mugiye kwinjira mukacegukira.
Nihagira ico musezeranira Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ntimuzotevye kugishitsa, kuko mwobiharurwako nk’icaha.
Ariko nimutagira ico musezerana, ntimuzobiharurwako nk’icaha.
Ico muzosezeranisha akanwa kanyu, muzogishitse, kuko mwagisezeraniye Uhoraho Imana yanyu ata wubagobereye.
Nimwinjira mu ruzabibu rwa bagenzi banyu, muzorye inzabibu mushaka zose ariko ntihagire izo muzokwamurira mu giseke ngo muzitahane.
Nimwinjira mu mirima y’ingano y’ababanyi banyu, muzoce izo mushaka zose muhekenye, ariko ntimuzogenyeshe urukero izihagaze.

Umugabo niyabira umugore hanyuma agahitamwo kuvana na we kuko yasanze hari ikintu kitari ciza gituma batoshishikara kubana, azomwandikire urwandiko rwemeza ko bavanye, arumuhe hanyuma aheze amwirukane.
Niyamara kugenda, azoba afise uburenganzira bwo kwubakana n’uwundi mugabo.
Ariko uwo wa kabiri na we nyene niyamwanka, akamuha urwandiko rwemeza ko bahukanye, canke uwo mugabo agapfa,

wa mugabo wa mbere ntazoba yemerewe gusubira kubana n’uwo mugore kuko azoba yarahumanijwe. Ivyo bizoba ari ikizira k’ Uhoraho . Ntimuze mukwegere ivyaha mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye nk’iragi.
Umugabo aherutse kurongora ntazorungikwe ku rugamba, canke ngo azezwe ibindi bikorwa. Aze ahabwe akaruhuko amare umwaka wose abana n’umugore wiwe yarongoye kugira ngo amunezereze.
Ntihaze hagire uwutwara urusyo, eka naho yoba ingasiro yonyene, kw’ingwati, kuko ni nk’aho yoba atwaye ubuzima bwa nyenevyo.
Nihagira uwufatwa yanyuruje mwenewabo w’Umwisirayeli, akamugira umugurano wiwe canke akamugurisha, uwo muntu azokwicwe. Mutegerezwa gukura ikibi muri mwebwe.
Niwagwara ingwara zihumanya zifatira ku rukoba, uze wiyubare kugira ngo ukore uko abaherezi ari bo Balewi bazokubwira. Muze mukurikize neza ivyo nabategetse.
Mwibuke ivyo Uhoraho Imana yanyu yagiriye Miriyamu muri mu rugendo muva muri Egiputa.
Nimwaha ingurane umubanyi, ntimuze mwinjire mu nzu y’uwo mwaguranye gutora ico yatanze nk’ingwati.
Muze mugume hanze mureke uwo mubanyi yinjire wenyene, abe ari we ayibazanira hanze.
Nimba uwo mubanyi ari umukene, akaguha umutamana wiwe nk’ingwati ntuzoryame utarawumusubiza.
Uzomusubize umutamana wiwe izuba ritararenga, kuko ashobora kuba ata wundi afise yipfuka. Azobigushimira kandi uzobiharurwako nk’ukugororoka mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze muhahaze umukozi ngo ni uko ari umworo kandi akenye, yaba mwenewanyu w’Umwisirayeli canke umunyamahanga aba muri kimwe mu bisagara vyanyu.
Muzomuhe impembo abereye izuba ritararenga kuko ari umukene, kandi akaba ari yo imubeshejeho. Bitabaye uko, azoririra Uhoraho abarega, na we abibaharureko nk’icaha.
Ntihaze hagire umuvyeyi yicwa azira abana biwe, canke abana ngo bicwe bazira abavyeyi babo, umwe wese azozire ivyaha vyiwe.
Muze mucire izibereye abanyamahanga hamwe n’impfuvyi baba muri mwebwe, kandi ntimuze mutware umutamana w’umupfakazi kw’ingwati.
Mwibuke ko mwabaye abagurano muri Egiputa, Uhoraho Imana yanyu akabarokora. Ni co gituma ndabategeka ivyo.

Igihe muzoba muriko murimbura ingano mu mirima yanyu, hanyuma hakagira umukama murengana, ntimuze musubire inyuma kuwutora, muze muzirekere ba kavantara, impfuvyi n’abapfakazi, kugira ngo Uhoraho Imana yanyu azohezagire ibikorwa vy’intoke zanyu.
Nimwaja kwamura imyelayo, ntimuzokubite ishami kabiri. Muzokubite rimwe, iyisigayeko muzoyirekere abanyamahanga, impfuvyi n’abapfakazi.
Nimwimbura inzabibu, ntimuze musubireyo. Izisigaye mu mirima muze muzirekere abanyamahanga, impfuvyi n’abapfakazi.
Mwibuke ko mwabaye abagurano muri Egiputa. Ni co gituma ndabategetse ivyo.
Abantu babiri nibagira ico bapfa, baze bashire urubanza rwabo abacamanza, na bo baruce, batunganirize uwutaco yagirizwa, uwo icaha cagiriye ahanwe.
Nimba uwatsinzwe n’icaha aciriwe urubanza rwo gukubitwa, abacamanza bazomuryamike hasi bamukubitishe imbere yabo, akubitwe izihwanye n’icaha camwagiriye,
ariko ntazokubitwe izirenga mirongo ine. Niyakubitwa izirenga mirongo ine, Umwisirayeli mwenewanyu azoba ateterejwe mu maso yanyu.
Ntimuze mwugare umunwa w’inka iriko irasekura ingano.

Abahungu bavukana nibaba babana hanyuma umwe agapfa atavyaye umuhungu, umugore asize ntazorongorwe mu wundi muryango. Mwenewabo n’umugabo wiwe azomutware abe umugore wiwe, amukorere ivyo muramu w’umuntu abwirizwa kumukorera.
Umuhungu wa mbere azovyara azokwitwe izina ry’uwo mwenewabo yapfuye, kugira ngo izina ryiwe ntiryibagirwe muri Isirayeli.

Ariko natagomba kurongora uwo mugore yasizwe na mwenewabo, uwo mugore azoce aja kw’irembo ry’igisagara abarire abatware ati: “Mwenewabo n’umugabo wanje yanse gukomeza izina rya mwenewabo muri Isirayeli. Yanse kunkorera ivyo muramu w’umuntu abwirizwa kumukorera.”
Maze abatware b’igisagara abamwo bazoce bamuhamagaza, babimubaze. Niyashishikara avuga ati: “Sinshaka kumucura,”
wa mupfakazi azoce amwegera, imbere y’abatware, amwambure ikirato kimwe, amucire amate mu maso, avuge ati: “Uko ni ko uwanse gukomeza umuryango wa mwenewabo agirirwa.”
Umuryango w’uwo mugabo uzomenyekane mu Bisirayeli witwe umuryango w’Uwambuwe ikirato.
Abagabo babiri b’Abisirayeli nibaba bariko baragwana, hanyuma umugore w’umwe muri abo akaza kumutabara, hanyuma agafata amagara y’uwo agwana n’umugabo wiwe,
muze mumuce ukuboko. Ntimuze mumugirire impuhwe.
Ntimuzogire amabuye abiri atandukanye y’umunzane mw’isaho imwe, rimwe rikwije ibilo n’irindi ridakwije.
Ntimuzogire imetero zibiri mu nzu zanyu, imwe ikwiye n’iyindi idakwiye.
Muzogire umunzane n’imetero bikwiye kandi vy’ukuri kugira ngo muzorambire mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye.
Kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu yanka uwukora bene ivyo, yanka uwufise ubugunge mu rudandazwa wese.
Mwibuke ivyo Abamaleki babagiriye muri mu rugendo muva muri Egiputa.
Babateye babaciye inyuma, igihe mwari murushe, mwadendebukiwe, bica abari bagikwega amaguru inyuma, kuko batari bafise ukwubaha Imana muri bo.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu niyamara kubaha akaruhuko mu gihugu abahaye nk’iragi, muzorandure Abamaleki bibagirwe musi y’ijuru.
Nimwamara kwinjira mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye nk’iragi, mukacegukira mukakibamwo,

muze mufate ku vyeze vya mbere mwimbuye mu mirima yanyu yo mu gihugu Uhoraho abahaye, mubishire mu giseke. Hanyuma muze mubijane muri ca kibanza Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yaratoranije, aho Izina ryayo rizohimbarizwa
hanyuma mubwire umuherezi azoba ariko akora ico gikorwa c’ubuherezi ico gihe muti: “Ndemeje uno musi imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yawe ko nashitse mu gihugu Uhoraho yarahiye ba sogokuruza ko azokiduha.”
Umuherezi azokwakira ico giseke, agitereke imbere y’igicaniro c’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.

Maze muze muvugire imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu muti: “Sogokuruza wacu Yakobo yari Umwaramu atagira aho aba hanyuma amanuka muri Egiputa ajanye n’abantu bakeya, hanyuma baragwira baba ihanga rinini kandi rikomeye.
Ariko Abanyegiputa baraducinyiza, baratubabaza, batugira abagurano babo.
Maze dutakambira Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza, na we yumva ugutakamba kwacu, abona amagorwa yacu, imiruho n’agacinyizo twarimwo.
Uhoraho adukura muri Egiputa n’ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi kandi kuramvuye, n’ibiteye ubwoba vyinshi, hamwe n’ibitangaza n’utwumiza.
Yatuzanye muri kino kibanza, aduha kino gihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki,
none rero, nshikanye ivyeze vya mbere vyo mu mirima wewe Uhoraho wampaye.” Muce mutereka ico giseke imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu hanyuma mwikubite imbere yayo muyipfukamire.
Hanyuma, mwe n’Abalewi n’abanyamahanga baba hagati muri mwebwe, muze muce munezerwa muhimbaze Uhoraho Imana yanyu, munezererwe ivyo azoba yabahaye mwe n’abo mu nzu zanyu.

Niwamara gushira ku ruhande ikigiracumi c’ivyo wimbuye mu mwaka ugira gatatu, ari wo mwaka w’ikigiracumi, uze ugihe Abalewi, abanyamahanga, impfuvyi n’abapfakazi, kugira ngo na bo baronke ivyo barya bahagire mu bisagara vyanyu.

Muze mwongere mubwire Uhoraho Imana yanyu muti: “Nakuye mu nzu yanje umuce watoranijwe, ndawuha Abalewi, abanyamahanga, impfuvyi n’abapfakazi, nk’uko wabidutegetse. Sinaciye i ruhande ngo nyuranye n’amabwirizwa yawe, sinibagiye na rimwe muri yo.

Sinariye umuce watoranijwe igihe nari ngandaye, canke ngo ngire ico ndawukurako igihe nari ngihumanye, canke ngo nkureko ivyo nshikanira abapfuye. Nagamburukiye Uhoraho Imana yanje, nakoze ivyo wantegetse vyose.
None rero, undabe uri mw’ijuru, ahera hawe, uhezagire abantu bawe ba Isirayeli, hamwe n’igihugu wari wasezeraniye ba sogokuruza bacu ko uzokiduha, igihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki.”
Uhoraho Imana yanyu abategetse gukurikiza aya mabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe, muzovyubahe n’imitima yanyu yose, n’imishaha yanyu yose.
Mwemeje uwu musi ko Uhoraho ari yo Mana yanyu, kandi ko muzogendera mu nzira ziwe, mukazigama amabwirizwa, amategeko n’ivyagezwe vyiwe, kandi ko muzomwubaha.
Uhoraho na we, uwu musi yemeje ko muri abantu biwe, itunga yiharije nk’uko yabisezeranye, kandi ko mutegerezwa kuzokwama mugendera mu vyagezwe vyiwe.
Nimwabikurikiza, azobashira hejuru y’ayandi mahanga yose yaremye. Abandi bazobashimagiza, babubahe, mumenyekane mu mahanga. Muzoba ihanga ryera ry’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nk’uko yabisezeranye.
Mose n’abatware b’Abisirayeli bategeka abantu bati: “Muze muzigame amabwirizwa yose ndabahaye uno musi.
Nimwajabuka Yorodani mugashika mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye, muze muhagarike amabuye maninimanini, muyasige ishwagara.

Hanyuma, igihe muzoba mumaze kujabuka, mugashika mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye, igihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki nk’uko Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza yabibasezeraniye, muze muyandikeko amajambo yose y’ibi Vyagezwe.
Kandi, nimwamara kujabuka Yorodani, ayo mabuye muze muyashinge ku musozi Ebalu, nk’uko ndabibategetse uno musi, muyasige ishwagara.
Muze muhubakire Uhoraho Imana yanyu igicaniro, mucubake mu mabuye. Ntimuze muyabazishe ivyuma.
Muze mwubake igicaniro c’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu mucubakishe amabuye yo mu gahinga, mugishikanireko Uhoraho Imana yanyu amashikanwa yo guturirwa.
Muze muhashikanire amashikanwa y’ishimwe, murye mwongere muhimbarirwe imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Muze mwandike mu ndome zisomeka amajambo y’ibi Vyagezwe kuri ayo mabuye muzoba mwashinze.”
Mose n’abaherezi, ari bo Balewi, baca babwira Abisirayeli bati: “Yemwe Bisirayeli, nimucereze mwumvirize! Uwu musi mubaye ubwoko bw’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Mwubahe Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mukurikize amategeko n’ivyagezwe vyiwe, ndabahaye uno musi.”
Uwo musi nyene Mose aca aha abantu ayo mabwirizwa, avuga ati:
“Nimwamara kujabuka Yorodani, iyi miryango izoje ku musozi Gerizimu bature ku bantu imihezagiro: umuryango wa Simeyoni, uwa Lewi, uwa Yuda, uwa Isakari, uwa Yosefu, n’uwa Benyamini.
Iyi ikurikira na yo izohagarare ku musozi Ebalu yature imivumo: umuryango wa Reyubeni, uwa Gadi, uwa Asheri, uwa Zebuloni, uwa Dani n’uwa Nafutali.
Abalewi baze basemerere n’ijwi rirenga, babwire Abisirayeli bose bati:
‘Haravumwe umuntu azokwibazira ikigirwamana, ikintu gisesema Uhoraho ; igikorwa c’amaboko y’umucuzi, akagishinga mu mpisho.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati: ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu atubaha se na nyina.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu ashingura akarimbi k’umubanyi wiwe.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu azimiza impumyi.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu adacira urubanza rugororotse umunyamahanga, impfuvyi n’umupfakazi.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu aryamana n’umugore wa se, kuko aba ahumanije uburiri bwa se.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu asambana n’igikoko ico ari co cose.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu aryamana na mushikiwe, umwana wa se canke wa nyina.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu asambana na inabukwe’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu yica umubanyi wiwe yihishije.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu yakira ingero yo kwica umuntu ata co azira.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
‘Haravumwe umuntu adakurikiza ibi Vyagezwe, ntashire mu ngiro ico bivuga.’ Maze abantu bose bazokwishure bati ‘Amen!’
Nimwubaha Uhoraho Imana yanyu, n’imitima yanyu yose, mugakurikiza amabwirizwa yiwe ndabahaye uwu musi, Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobashira hejuru y’ayandi mahanga yose.
Nimwubaha Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ng’iyi imihezagiro izobakurikira:
Muzogira imihezagiro mu bisagara no mu matongo.
Abana banyu, imirima yanyu n’ibitungwa vyanyu bizohezagirwa.
Ibiseke vyanyu n’amato yanyu mucumbiramwo bizohezagirwa.
Muzohezagirwa amaja n’amaza.
Uhoraho azobaha kunesha abansi bazobahagurukira ngo babatere. Bazobatera bazananye inzira imwe, basubire inyuma bajanye inzira indwi.
Uhoraho azohezagira ibigega vyanyu, n’ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu vyose. Uhoraho Imana yanyu azohezagira igihugu abahaye.
Uhoraho azobagira ihanga ryera nk’uko yabisezeranishije indahiro, nimwakurikiza amabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mukagendera mu nzira ziwe.
Ni ho ayandi mahanga yo kw’isi yose azomenya ko mwitirirwa Uhoraho , maze abatinye.
Uhoraho azobasesekariza ivyiza mu gihugu yarahiye ba sogokuruza ko azokibaha, abagwirize uruvyaro, ibitungwa n’ivyimburwa.

Uhoraho azobugururira ubutunzi bwiwe butangaje bwo mw’ijuru, abarungikire imvura igihe kibereye, ahezagire n’ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu. Amahanga azobasaba ingurane ariko mwebwe nta we muzosaba ingurane.

Uhoraho azobagira umutwe, ntazobagira umurizo. Nimwitondera amabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu ndabahaye uwu musi, mukayakurikiza neza yose, muzokwama muri hejuru y’abandi, ntimuzigera muja musi yabo.
Ntihaze hagire ibwirizwa na rimwe mwirengagiza mu yo ndabahaye uno musi, canke ngo muhengamire i buryo canke i bubamfu, canke ngo mukurikire izindi mana canke ngo muzikorere.
Ariko nimutubaha Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ntimukurikize amabwirizwa n’amategeko ndabahaye uwu musi, ng’iyi imivumo izobakurikira:
Muzovumwa mu bisagara no mu matongo.
Ibiseke n’amato yanyu muganiramwo bizovumwa.
Abana banyu bazovumwa, imirima yanyu izovumwa, n’ibitungwa vyanyu bizovumwa.
Muzovumwa mugenda, muvumwe mugaruka.
Uhoraho azobarungikira umuvumo, abatere kuzazanirwa, avume igikorwa cose muzokora kugeza murandurwe mugahera kubera ikibi muzoba mwakoze mu kumuvako.
Uhoraho azobarungikamwo icago c’ingwara gushika mutikiriye mu gihugu mugiye kwinjiramwo ngo mucegukire.
Uhoraho azobakubitisha ingwara yo kubora mu magufa, ibatere umururumbo n’ibiturika, mugende mwuma mu magara, uruzuba n’ubugaragwa, ururyi no kurumvya bizobahwikira kugeza muherengeteye.
Hejuru yanyu, ijuru rizobamerera nk’ubutare bwitwa umuringa, isi na yo musi y’ibirenge vyanyu ibamerere nk’icuma.
Uhoraho azorungika umusenyi n’umukungugu mu gishingo c’imvura, bizogwa gushika murandutse.
Uhoraho azotuma muneshwa n’abansi banyu. Muzobatera mujanye inzira imwe, mubahunge muciye mu nzira indwi. Muzoba muri ibicibwa imbere y’ubwami bwose bwo kw’isi.
Imivyimba yanyu izoba inyama z’ibisiga vyo mu kirere n’iz’ibikoko vyo kw’isi, kandi nta n’uwuzovyamira.
Uhoraho azobateza ibihute nk’ivyo yateje Egiputa, abatere ibivyimba, ibisebe n’urukushi bidakira.
Uhoraho azobababarisha ibisazi, ubuhumyi, n’ukuzazanirwa mu bwenge bwanyu.
Ku murango muzozimagirika nk’impumyi yama mu mwijima. Ivyo muzokora vyose nta na kimwe kizogenda neza, muzocinyizwa umusi ku wundi, musahurwe utwanyu ata gitabara.
Muzokwa abageni, ariko batwarwe n’abandi, babarongore ku nguvu. Muzokwubaka amazu, ariko ntimuzoyabamwo. Muzotera inzabibu, ariko ntimuzorya ivyamwa vyazo.
Inka zanyu zizobagirwa mu maso yanyu, ariko nta n’imwe muzoryako. Indogoba zanyu muzozakwa ku nguvu kandi ntimuzozisubizwa. Intama zanyu zizohabwa abansi banyu, kandi nta wuzobatabara.
Abahungu banyu n’abakobwa banyu bazotwarwa mu mahanga nk’abaja, kandi amaso yanyu azokoboka muriko mubiraba umusi ku wundi, ata co mushobora gukora.
Abantu mutigeze mumenya bazorya ivyimburwa mwabiriye akuya, kandi nta co muzohembwa atari agacinyizo katavugwa ukubaho kwanyu kwose.
Ivyo muzobonesha amaso yanyu bizobatera gusara.
Uhoraho azobateza ibihute bidakira ku mavi no ku maguru, bizova mu bworo bw’ikirenge bishike ku mutwe.
Uhoraho azobirukanana n’umwami mwiyimikiye, muje mu gihugu na ba sogokuruza banyu batigeze bamenya. Ni ho muzosengera imana zibajwe mu biti no mu mabuye.
Muzoba nk’ibicibwa, mucike umugani, mushinyagurizwe n’amahanga Uhoraho azoba yabashwiragirijemwo.
Muzobiba vyinshi mwimbure bike kuko inzige zizoba zabiriye.
Muzotera imizabibu muyibagarire ariko ntimuzonywa umuvinyu, nta n’inzabibu muzosoroma kuko inyo zizoba zaziriye.
Igihugu canyu kizoba cuzuye ibiti vy’imyelayo, ariko ntimuzigera mukoresha amavuta, kuko imyelayo izoba yarahungurutse.
Muzovyara abahungu n’abakobwa ariko ntimuzobarera, kuko bazoca batwarwa mu buja.
Inzige zizotikiza ibiti vyose vyo mu gihugu canyu.
Abanyamahanga baba muri mwebwe bazogenda bashirwa hejuru, namwe mugende mucishwa bugufi.
Bazobagurana, ariko mwebwe ntimuzobagurana. Bazoba umutwe, namwe mube umurizo.
Iyi mivumo yose izobashikako. Izobakurikirana ibafate, gushika muherengeteye, kuko muzoba mutubashe Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ntimukurikize amabwirizwa n’amategeko yabahaye.
Izoba ibitangaza n’utwumiza kuri mwebwe no ku ruvyaro rwanyu.
Kuko mutazoba mwakoreye Uhoraho Imana yanyu munezerewe n’imitima ibikunze mugifise umusesekara mu gihe c’iterambere,
ni co gituma muzokorera abansi Uhoraho azobarungikira kubagwanya mufise inzara, inyota, mwambaye ubusa, muri mu bukene butavugwa. Bazobashira mu buja kugeza babaranduye.
Uhoraho azobagomorerako ihanga ribatere rivuye kure, ku mpera y’isi, baze nk’inkukuma yirasa kw’isi gufata ico irya, ihanga rivuga ururimi mutazi,
ihanga riteye ubwoba, ritubaha uwushaje canke ngo rigirire impuhwe uwukiri muto.

Bazorya ibitungwa vyanyu n’ibiterwa vyanyu gushika muherengeteye. Nta ngano bazobasigira, nta muvinyu musha canke amavuta ya Elayo, nta nyana z’ibitungwa canke imyagazi y’imikuku yanyu gushika biherengeteye vyose.
Bazokwugariza ibisagara vyo mu gihugu canyu, gushika aho n’inzitiro zikomeye mwishimiye zihomvokera hasi. Bazokwugariza ibisagara vyose vyo mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu abahaye.
Kubera imibabaro abansi banyu bazobateza mu gihe co kwugarizwa, muzorya abana banyu, murye inyama z’abahungu n’abakobwa Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yarabahaye.
N’umugabo w’inyankamugayo wo muri mwebwe ntazogirira imbabazi mwenewabo canke umugore wiwe akunda, canke abana biwe,
ntazobahako na gatoya ku nyama z’abana biwe azoba ariko ararya. Nta kindi azoba asigaranye, kubera amagorwa abansi banyu bazoba babateye mu gihe bazoba bugarije ibisagara vyanyu vyose.
Umugore w’umutima kandi w’inyankamugayo rwose muri mwebwe, ku buryo yiyubara no gukandagira kw’isi azogunga umugabo yakunda n’umuhungu wiwe n’umukobwa wiwe
abime ku ngovyi y’abana avyaye, kuko azoba agomba kuyirya wenyene yinyegeje mu gihe muzoba muri mu mibabaro abansi banyu bazobateza mu kwugariza ibisagara vyanyu.
Nimutakurikiza amajambo yose y’ibi Vyagezwe, yanditswe muri iki gitabu, kandi ngo mwubahe iri zina ryiwe ryiza kandi rihambaye ari ryo Uhoraho Imana yanyu,
Uhoraho azorungika ivyago biteye ubwoba kuri mwebwe no ku ruvyaro rwanyu. Ivyo vyago bizoba bikomeye, mubure agahengekerezo, mugwaye ingwara zidakira.
Azobateza za ngwara zo muri Egiputa mwatinya, kandi zizobomako.
Uhoraho azobashitsako n’ingwara n’ivyago bindi bitanditswe muri iki Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe, gushika muherengeteye.
Naho mwagwiriye mukangana n’inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru, muzosigara muri inkehwa, kuko mwanse kwubaha Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Nk’uko Uhoraho vyamuhimbara kubateza imbere no kubagwiza, ni ko bizomuhimbara kubakokora no kubarandura. Muzorandurwa mu gihugu mugiye kwinjiramwo ngo mucegukire.
Uhoraho azobasanzaza mu mahanga yose, uhereye ku mpera imwe y’isi ugashitsa ku yindi. Ni ho muzosenga imana zabajwe mu biti no mu mabuye, izo mwe na ba sogokuruza banyu mutigeze mubona.

Muri ayo mahanga ntimuzigera muronka akaruhuko, canke aho mushinga ikirenge mutekaniwe. Aho muzoba muri muri ayo mahanga, Uhoraho azobateza guhagarika imitima, amaso yanyu ajemwo uruhumyi, imitima yanyu idendebukirwe.
Ubuzima bwanyu buzomera nk’aho ata bwo mugira, mwame mwuzuye ubwoba bw’urupfu ku murango no mw’ijoro, mwumva ko ata cizere ca kazoza mufise.
Mu gatondo muzovuga muti: ‘Ese twobona burije!’ Mw’ijoro na ho muvuge muti: ‘Ese twobona burakeye!’ Kuko muzoterwa ubwoba n’ivyo amaso yanyu azobona.

Uhoraho azobasubiza muri Egiputa muri mu bwato, urugendo nabihanikirije nti ntimuzosubire kurufata. Ni ho muzokwidandaza mwebwe nyene ku bansi banyu nk’abagurano n’abaguranokazi, ariko nta n’umwe azobagura.”
Aya ni yo majambo y’isezerano Uhoraho yatumye Mose ngo asezerane n’Abisirayeli mu gihugu c’i Mowabu, isezerano ryiyongera ku ryo yari yaragiranye na bo ku musozi Horebu.
Mose akoranya Abisirayeli bose, arababwira ati: “Amaso yanyu yariboneye ivyo Uhoraho yakoze muri Egiputa, abikoreye Farawo, abatware biwe n’igihugu cose.
Amaso yanyu yariboneye ivyo bigeragezo bikomeye, ivyo bimenyetso n’ivyo bitangaza.
Ariko gushika uno musi Uhoraho ntiyabahaye ubwenge butahura, amaso abona canke amatwi yumva.
Mu myaka mirongo ine nabarongoye mu bugaragwa, impuzu zanyu n’ibirato vyanyu ntivyigeze bishira.
Nta mukate mwariye, nta muvinyu canke ibindi binyobwa bituriranije mwanyoye. Ivyo nabibakoreye kugira ngo mumenye ko ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Igihe mwashika muri iki gihugu, Sihoni umwami wa Heshiboni na Ogi umwami w’i Bashani baje kubatera, ariko turabanesha.
Twafashe igihugu cabo tugiha umuryango wa Reyubeni nk’iragi ryawo, uwa Gadi hamwe n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase.
None rero muzokwitondere ibigize iri sezerano kugira ngo muzotere imbere mu vyo muzokora vyose.
Mwese muhagaze ngaha imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu: abakuru b’imiryango, abatware, namwe bagabo b’Abisirayeli mwese,
muri kumwe n’abana banyu, abagore banyu, muri kumwe kandi n’abanyamahanga baba mu makambi yanyu, babasenyera bakabavomera.
Muhagaze ngaha kugira ngo mugiranire isezerano n’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu; iryo Uhoraho agira agirane namwe uwu musi arishigikije indahiro,
kugira ngo abagire abantu biwe, na we abe Imana yanyu nk’uko yabirahiye ba sogokuruza banyu Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo.
Iri sezerano rishigikijwe indahiro sindarigiranye namwe muhagararanye natwe hano uwu musi imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yacu gusa,
ariko ndarigiranye n’urundi runganwe rutari hano uwu musi.
Ubwanyu murazi ingene twabaye muri Egiputa n’ukuntu twarenganye ibihugu vyinshi kugira ngo dushike hano.
Mwarabonye ibishushanyo vyabo biteye isoni, ibigirwamana vyabo bibajwe mu biti no mu mabuye hamwe n’ibicuzwe mu nzahabu no mw’ifeza.

Muze mwirinde ntihaze hagire umugabo, umugore, inzu canke umuryango n’umwe wo muri mwebwe uzokura umutima k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu ngo basenge imana z’ayo mahanga. Muze mwirinde ntihaze hagire umuzi umera ukazana imbuto irura y’uburozi.
Abumvise amajambo y’iyi ndahiro, ntimuzopfe kwiyaturako iyo migisha muvuga muti: ‘Tuzoba impore n’aho twokwigumira mu nzira zacu.’ Ivyo bizozanira guhona isi ibomvye co kimwe n’iyumye.
Uhoraho ntazobababarira, uburake bwiwe n’ishaka ryiwe bizobaziriringira. Imivumo yose yanditswe muri iki gitabu izobakurikirana, kandi Uhoraho azozimanganya amazina yabo musi y’ijuru.
Uhoraho azobatandukanya n’iyindi miryango y’Abisirayeli, abarundeko imivumo yose iri mw’isezerano riri muri iki gitabu c’Ivyagezwe.
Uruvyaro rwanyu ruzokwaruka mu nyuma hamwe n’abanyamahanga bazoza bavuye mu bihugu vya kure bazobona ivyago vyashikiye igihugu canyu n’ingwara Uhoraho yagiteje.

Igihugu canyu cose kizoba nk’ikiyigira gitongojwe umunyu n’ibizuku, nta kizosubira kuhaterwa, nta kizomera, nta bizosubira kuhakura. Hazoba agatikizo nk’akabaye i Sodomu, n’i Gomora, Adima na Zeboyimu, ivyo Uhoraho yasutseko uburake bwiwe.
Amahanga yose azobaza ati: ‘Ni kubera iki Uhoraho yakoreye ibi iki gihugu? Ni kubera iki yagisutseko ubu burake bw’inkazi?’
Abantu bazokwishura bati: ‘Ni kubera abantu bataye isezerano ry’ Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza, isezerano yabagiriye igihe yabakura muri Egiputa.
Barayitaye basenga izindi mana, barazunamira, imana batari bwigere babona, imana zitari zivuye k’ Uhoraho .
Ni co catumye uburake bw’ Uhoraho bururumbira iki gihugu, maze agishitsako imivumo yose yanditse muri iki gitabu.
Uhoraho yabaranduranye uburake bwinshi, abakura mu gihugu cabo, abirukanira mu kindi gihugu iyo bari gushika n’ubu.’
Ibikiri mw’ibanga ni ivy’ Uhoraho Imana yacu, ariko ibintu bimaze guhishurwa ni ivyacu hamwe n’abana bacu ibihe vyose, kugira ngo dukurikize amajambo y’ibi Vyagezwe.
Iyi migisha n’iyi mivumo yose nshize imbere yanyu niyamara kubashikako muri mu bihugu Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoba yarabashwiragijemwo,
hanyuma mwe n’abana banyu mukagaruka k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu mukamwubahisha imitima yanyu n’imishaha yanyu yose mu gukora ivyo ndababwiye vyose uwu musi,
ico gihe Uhoraho Imana yanyu azokwongera abiyegereze, abagirire impuhwe abagarukane abakuye mu mahanga azoba yarabashwiragijemwo.
Naho muzoba mwarasabagiriye mu mahanga ya kure ku mpera z’isi, Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobegeranya abagarukane.
Azobasubiza mu gihugu ca ba sogokuruza, musubire mucegukire. Azobaha kwongera gutera imbere no kuba benshi kurusha ba sogokuruza banyu.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu azokeba imitima yanyu n’iy’uruvyaro rwanyu, kugira ngo mumukunde n’imitima yanyu yose, n’imishaha yanyu yose, mubone kubaho.
Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoshira iyi mivumo ku bansi banyu, babanka bakongera bakabahama.
Muzosubira kwubaha Uhoraho , mukurikize aya mabwirizwa ndabahaye uwu musi.

Maze Uhoraho Imana yanyu na we azoteza imbere ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu, agwize uruvyaro rwanyu, agwize ibitungwa vyanyu, agwize n’umwimbu wanyu. Uhoraho azosubira abateze imbere, abanezerererwe nk’uko yanezerererwa ba sogokuruza banyu,
nimwamwumvira mukagendera mu vyagezwe vyiwe, vyanditswe muri iki Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe, mukagaruka k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu n’imitima yanyu yose n’imishaha yanyu yose.
Amabwirizwa ndabahaye uno musi ntagoye gutahura, kandi ntari aho mudashobora gushika.
Ntanyegejwe mw’ijuru aho mwovuga muti: ‘Ni nde yoduga mw’ijuru akaja kuyatuzanira no kuyatubwira hanyuma tukabona kuyakurikiza?’
Kandi ntabitswe hakurya y’ikiyaga, aho mwogira muti: ‘Ni nde yojabuka ikiyaga akaja kuyatuzanira no kuyatubwira hanyuma tukabona kuyakurikiza?’
Haba na mba, ijambo riri hafi yawe; riri mu kanwa kawe no ku mutima wawe kugira ngo ushobore kuryumvira.
Ehe raba, uwu musi nshize imbere yanyu ubuzima n’imigisha, urupfu no kuranduka.

Uwu musi ndabahaye ibwirizwa ryo gukunda Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kugendera mu nzira zayo, no kuzigama amabwirizwa, amategeko n’ivyagezwe vyiwe; ni ho muzobaho, mukagwira, Uhoraho Imana yanyu akabahezagirira mu gihugu mugiye kwinjira ngo mucegukire.
Ariko imitima yanyu niyava ku Mana ntimuyumvire, canke naho nimwahindukira mukunamira izindi mana mukazisenga,
uwu musi ndababwije ukuri ko muzorandurwa. Ntimuzorambira mu gihugu mugira mujabuke Yorodani ngo mucinjiremwo mugifate.
Uwu musi ntoye ijuru n’isi nk’ivyabona, ko nshize imbere yanyu ubuzima n’imigisha, urupfu no kuranduka. Rero nimuhitemwo ubuzima kugira ngo mwe n’abana banyu mushobore kubaho,
mu gukunda Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mu kumwumvira, no mu kwifatanya na we. Kuko Uhoraho ari we buzima bwanyu, azobaha kurambira mu gihugu yarahiye ko azoha ba sogokuruza Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo.”
Mose yongera abwira Abisirayeli ati:
“Ehe raba maze imyaka ijana na mirongo ibiri, singishoboye kubarongora. Uhoraho yambwiye ati: ‘Ntuzojabuka Yorodani.’
Uhoraho Imana yanyu ubwiwe azobagendera imbere. Azorandura amahanga yose ariyo, maze namwe mubanyage igihugu cabo. Yosuwa azobajabukana nk’uko Uhoraho yabisezeranye.
Uhoraho azogirira ayo mahanga nk’uko yagiriye Sihoni na Ogi abami b’Abamori, abo yaranduranye n’igihugu cabo.
Uhoraho azobarekurira mu maboko yanyu, maze namwe muzobagire nk’uko yabategetse.
Mushikame, mushire ubwoba. Ntimuzotinye ngo mucike intege kubera ayo mahanga, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu azojana namwe. Ntazobaheba, ntazobata.”

Maze Mose ahamagara Yosuwa, ahagarara imbere y’Abisirayeli, amubwira ati: “Shikama ushire ubwoba, kuko ari wewe uzotwara ubu bwoko mu gihugu Uhoraho yarahiye ba sekuruza babo ko azokibaha, kandi uzokibagaburire nk’iragi.
Uhoraho wenyene azogendera imbere yanyu. Ntazobata, ntazobaheba. Ntutinye kandi ntucike intege.”
Nuko Mose yandika ivyo Vyagezwe vyose mu gitabu, abiha abaherezi, ari bo bahungu ba Lewi, barerura Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho , agiha n’abatware b’Abisirayeli bose.
Maze Mose ababarira ati: “Ku mpera y’umwaka wose ugira indwi, ari wo mwaka wo guheberanira imyenda, mu misi mikuru y’insago,
mu gihe Abisirayeli bazoba bakoraniye imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu mu kibanza azoba yaratoranije, muzosomere imbere y’Abisirayeli bose ibi Vyagezwe.

Muzobakoranye bose: abagabo, abagore, abana n’abanyamahanga bazoba baba mu bisagara vyanyu, kugira ngo bumvirize bongere bige gutinya Uhoraho Imana bifatanije no kuyubaha, bongere bitondere aya majambo yose y’ibi Vyagezwe.

Abana babo batazi ibi vyagezwe bazovyumvirize bongere bige gutinya Uhoraho Imana yanyu bifatanije no kuyubaha. Muzokwame mugenza gutyo ibihe vyose muzoba muri ico gihugu mugiye kujabuka Yorodani ngo mucinjire.”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Igihe cawe co gupfa kirageze. Hamagara Yosuwa muzanane mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, kugira ngo ndamushikirize igikorwa.” Nuko Mose ajana na Yosuwa, binjira mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Maze Uhoraho aza mu nkingi y’igicu, ahagarara mu rwinjiriro rw’Ihema.

Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Ugiye kuruhuka, uhamvye ba sogokuruza. Niwamara kugenda, aba bantu bazokwigenza nka maraya mu kuja gusenga imana z’inyamahanga, imana zo muri iki gihugu bagira binjiremwo. Bazonta, barenge kw’isezerano nabagiriye.

Nanje uburake buzobaziriringira ndabate, ndabanyegeze mu nyonga hanje, kandi bazorandurwa. Ivyago vyinshi n’amagorwa menshi bizobashikako, kandi ico gihe bazovuga bati: ‘Ubwo ibi vyago ntibiriko bidushikako kuko Imana itari kumwe natwe?’
Ico gihe nanje koko nzobanyegeza mu nyonga hanje kubera ikibi bazoba bakoze mu guhindukirira izindi mana bakazisenga.
None rero niwandike aya majambo y’iyi ndirimbo, uyibigishe bayiririmbe, kugira ngo izombere icabona ku bwoko bw’Abisirayeli.

Kuko ninamara kubazana mu gihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki, igihugu nasezeranishije indahiro ba sogokuruza, bazotunga, barye, bahage, bavyibuhe. Ariko bazohindukira, basenge izindi mana, bante, barenge isezerano ryanje.

Ivyago n’amagorwa nivyabashikako, iyi ndirimbo izobabera icabona, kuko ntizokwigera yibagirwa mu ruvyaro rwabo. N’imbere y’uko ndabashikana mu gihugu nabasezeraniye ndahiye, ndazi ivyo biteguriye kuzokora.”
Maze Mose yandika iyo ndirimbo aca ayigisha Abisirayeli kuri uwo musi nyene.
Uhoraho abarira Yosuwa mwene Nuni ati: “Shikama ushire ubwoba, kuko ari wewe ugiye gushikana Abisirayeli mu gihugu nabasezeraniye ndahiye, kandi nanje ubwanje nzoba ndi kumwe nawe.”
Mose amaze kwandika Ivyagezwe vyose mu gitabu,
aca aha icagezwe Abalewi barerura Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho ati:
“Akira iki Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe mugishire i ruhande y’Isandugu y’Isezerano, ry’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Kizokwame ngaho nk’icabona kuri mwebwe.
Kuko ndazi ko muri ubwoko bw’abagarariji n’intagondwa. Nimba mwagararije Uhoraho nkiri kumwe namwe, mbega ntimuzorushiriza kugarariza ninamara gupfa?
Nimunkoranirize abakuru b’imiryango yose hamwe n’abatware banyu kugira ngo aya majambo yose ndayavuge bumva, nongere ntore n’isi n’ijuru nk’ivyabona kuri bo.

Kuko nzi neza ko ninamara gupfa muzokwononekara, mukava mu nzira nabategetse gucamwo. Mu bihe bizoza, ivyago bizobagwako kuko muzoba mwakoze ibibi imbere y’ Uhoraho , ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu bikamutera kuraka.”
Maze Mose asubiramwo amajambo y’iyo ndirimbo n’ijwi ryumvikana, kuva ku ntango gushika ku mpera, ikoraniro ry’Abisirayeli ryose ryumva, ati:
“Umviriza mwa majuru mwe, ngira mvuge; umviriza wa si we, amajambo y’akanwa kanje.
Inyigisho zanje nizibagweko nk’imvura, n’ijambo ryanje rimanuke nk’ikime. Amajambo yanje abamanukire nk’imvura igwa ku vyatsi bitotahaye, canke ikime kigwa ku vyatsi.
Nzomenyekanisha izina ry’ Uhoraho , nshimagize ubukuru bw’Imana yacu!
Ni urutare, ibikorwa vyiwe biratunganye, kandi inzira ziwe ziragororotse. Ni Imana yo kwizigirwa izira ikibi, iragororotse, ica izibereye.
Ariko ntibakiri abana bayo kuko bayihemukiye, ni urunganwe rw’abanyakibi, bagoramye.
Mbega mwa Bisirayeli b’ibipfu, ukwo ni ko musubirije mu nkoko Uhoraho ? Mbega si sowanyu, Umuremyi wanyu yabaremye, yababumvye?
Kubitiza agatima ku misi ya kera, mwibuke urunganwe rwarenganye. Baza ba sogokuruza banyu bazobabwira, musiguze abakurambere banyu na bo bazobasigurira.
Igihe Iyisumbavyose yagaburira abantu ibihugu, igihe yagabura abantu ku moko yabo, yabashingiye akarimbi ikurikije igitigiri c’abahungu ba Isirayeli.
Kuko Abisirayeli ari bo mugabane w’ Uhoraho , Yakobo na we akaba ari we ragi ryiwe.
Yamusanze mu bugaragwa, mu gihugu cumye ata kibamwo. Yaramushigikiye yongera amwitaho, amubungabunga nk’imbonero y’ijisho ryiwe,
nka kurya inkona yigisha ivyana vyayo kuguruka, ikabundikira ivyana bikiri bito, igasanza amababa yayo mu kubijana
Uhoraho wenyene ni we yamuja imbere, nta mana y’inyamahanga yari kumwe na we.
Yamucishije mu mitumba miremire, amugaburira ku vyamwa vyo mu mirima yaho. Yamugaburiye ku buki bwo mu gitandara, amuha no ku mavuta y’imyelayo yameze kw’isi y’urutare.
Yabahaye amata y’ikivuguto y’inka n’ay’intama, abagaburira n’ibinure vy’intama, abaha amapfizi y’intama n’impene y’i Bashani, hamwe n’ingano nziza. Mwanyoye ku mutobe uryoshe uganwe mu nzabibu.
Ariko Yeshuruni amaze kuvyibuha, antera akagere, amaze kurya agahaga, yaravyibushe, aratatagara. Maze ava ku Mana yamubumvye, akengera ca Gitandara c’agakiza kiwe.
Bayiteye kubagirira ishari mu gusenga imana z’inyamahanga bayirakisha ibizira bakoze.
Bashikaniye ibimazi abadayimoni atari Imana, bashikanira imana batari bwigere babona, imana nshasha z’ivyaduka, izo ba sekuruza batigeze batinya.
Mwagararije ca Gitandara cabavyaye, mwibagira Imana yabavyaye.
Uhoraho yarabibonye, aca arabazinukwa kuko yari ashavujwe n’abahungu n’abakobwa biwe.
Aravuga ati: ‘Nzobahisha mu nyonga hanje, maze ndabe amaherezo yabo; kuko ari urunganwe rwononekaye, abana atari abizigirwa.

Banteje ishari ibitari imana, uburake bwanje buraziriringa kubera ibigirwamana vyabo ata co bimaze. Nanje nzobateza kwipfuza ivy’abantu batari babereye no kwitwa ihanga, ndabateze kugirira ishari ihanga ritagira n’ugutahura.’
Kuko umuriro w’uburake bwanje wamaze kwaka, uturira gushitsa epfo i kuzimu. Uzotongora isi n’ibiyezeko, udomeke n’amatanguriro y’imisozi.
Nzobarundanyako ivyago, ndabamarireko imyampi yanje.
Nzobakonyesha inzara, inyonko n’izindi ngwara zica, nzobarekurira mu menyo y’ibikoko, ndabaterere no mu bumara bw’inzoka z’imvuvyi zikwega mu mukungugu.
Ku nzira, inkota izobamarira abana, i muhira, bose bazocika ivutu. Abagore n’abagabo bazotikira, co kimwe n’abana n’abatama.
Ndavuga nti nari nashatse kubashwiragiza, ngahanagura amazina yabo ntibazokwongere kwibukwa mu bantu,
ariko nanse agakekezo k’abansi babo, bari guhava babitahura ukundi, bakavuga bati: ‘Inkomezi zacu ni zo zabatsinze, si Uhoraho yabibagize.’
Ariko Isirayeli ni ihanga ata co ryiyumvira, nta bwenge bagira mu vyo bakora.
Iyo baba bafise ubwenge botahuye ibi, bakiyumvira kw’iherezo ryabo.
Mbega umuntu umwe yonesha abantu igihumbi, canke babiri bakirukana ibihumbi cumi? Ntivyoshoboka, kiretse ca Gitandara yabagurishije, Uhoraho yabarekuriye mu maboko yabo.
Kuko igitandara cabo kitameze nk’Igitandara cacu, n’abansi bacu baravyemeza.
Inzabibu zabo zakomotse ku muzabibu w’i Sodomu no mu mirima y’i Gomora. Inzabibu zabo zuzuye ubumara, amahando yazo ni umururazi.
Umuvinyu wabo ni ubumara bw’inzoka, ni ubumara bwica bw’inkoma.
Mbega ibi sinabishinguye mu bubiko, sinavyugaraniye ahabitse ubutunzi bwanje?
Uguhora ni ukwanje, ni jewe nzokwishura umuntu ibikwiranye n’ivyo yakoze. Igihe nicagera, ibirenge vyabo bizonyerera; umusi w’ivyago urabegereje, kandi ibitegerezwa kubashikako birabashitseko vuba.
Uhoraho azocira urubanza abantu biwe, kandi azogirira impuhwe abasavyi biwe, niyabona ko inkomezi zabo zose ziheze, ata n’umwe agisigaye, naho yoba umugurano canke uwidegemvya.
Azobaza ati: ‘Mbega imana zabo ziri hehe? Ca gitandara bahungirako kiri he?
Mbega izo mana ziri hehe, zimwe zarya ibinure vy’ibimazi vyabo, zikanywa n’imivinyu n’ibindi binyobwa bazishikanira? Nizihaguruke zibafashe, nizibahe ubuhungiro.’
None rero nimumenye ko jewe nyene ari jewe Mana. Nta yindi mana atari jewe. Ni jewe nica ngakiza, ni jewe nkomeretsa nkongera nkavura, kandi nta wushobora kugira ico arokora mu kuboko kwanje.
Ndugije ukuboko kwanje ndakurabisha kw’ijuru mvuga nti: Ndahiye ukubaho kwanje kw’ibihe vyose.
Ninakarisha inkota yanje ica ibibatsi, ukuboko kwanje kukayifata ngatangura guca imanza, nzokwihora abansi banje, nsubirize mu nkoko abanyanse.
Imyampi yanje nzoyiboreza amaraso, inkota yanje ndayigaburire imisoso: amaraso y’abishwe n’ay’abafashwe mpiri, ihekenye imitwe y’abatware b’abansi.
Yemwe banyamahanga, nimunezeranwe n’abantu bayo, kuko azohora amaraso y’abasavyi bayo; azokwihora abansi biwe, atange impongano ku gihugu c’ubwoko bwiwe.”
Mose azanana na Yosuwa mwene Nuni, avuga ayo majambo yose y’iyo ndirimbo abantu bose bamwumviriza.
Mose ahejeje gusubiriramwo ayo majambo Abisirayeli bose,
arababwira ati: “Mushire ku muzirikanyi amajambo yose ndababwiriye ku mugaragaro uwu musi, kugira ngo muzotegeke abana banyu gukurikiza neza amajambo y’ibi Vyagezwe.
Ayo majambo si ayasanzwe, ariko ni ubuzima bwanyu. Ni yo azobaha kurambira mu gihugu mugiye kwinjiramwo hakurya ya Yorodani ngo mucegukire.”
Uwo musi nyene Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Haguruka uduge mu misozi ya Abarimu, ushike i Nebo muri Mowabu, ahahereranye na Yeriko, wihweze Kanani, igihugu mpaye Abisirayeli nk’iragi ryabo.
Uwo musozi uza kudugako ni wo uza gupfirako, uhamvye ab’i wanyu bakwitangiye, nk’uko mwenewanyu Aroni yapfiriye ku musozi Hori, agasanga abamwitangiye imbere.
Ivyo ndabigize kuko mwempi mwampemukiye imbere y’Abisirayeli ku mazi y’i Meriba i Kadeshi mu bugaragwa bw’i Zini, kandi kuko muterekanye ukwera kwanje mu Bisirayeli.
Ni co gituma ico gihugu uzokirabira kure, ariko ntuzokwinjira mu gihugu mpaye ubwoko bwa Isirayeli.”
Uwu ni wo muhezagiro umuntu w’Imana Mose yahezagiye Abisirayeli imbere y’urupfu rwiwe.

Yavuze ati: “ Uhoraho yazananye i Sinayi, abarasira ari i Seyiri; yabakayanganiye ari ku musozi Parani. Yazananye n’ibihumbi cumi vy’abera, kandi imiriro ari vyo vyagezwe yava mu kuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo.
Ni ivy’ukuri urakunda abantu bawe; abera bose bari mu biganza vyawe. Bose bikubita ku birenge vyawe, bakumva amajambo avuye kuri wewe,
ari vyo Vyagezwe Mose yaduhaye, iragi ridasanzwe ku bwoko bwa Yakobo.
Uhoraho yari Umwami muri Yeshuruni igihe abatware bari bakoranye, imiryango yose y’Abisirayeli ikoraniye hamwe.
Ab’umuryango wa Reyubeni baragahoraho ntibagapfe, abiwe ntibakabe bake.”
Ku muryango wa Yuda, Mose yavuze ati: “ Uhoraho we, wumve amarira ya Yuda, umusubize mu bwoko bwiwe. Bahe inkomezi zo kwigwanira, ubashoboze kugwanya abansi babo.”
Abalewi Mose yabavuzeko ati: “Tumimu na Urimu zawe wazihaye Lewi umukozi wawe w’umwizigirwa. Wamugeragereje i Masa, utonganira na we ku mazi y’i Meriba.
Abalewi bumviye ijambo ryawe, bazigama isezerano ryawe. Bakurutishije abavyeyi babo, birengagije incuti zabo, ntibitaho abana babo.
Bazokwigisha Yakobo amabwirizwa yawe, na Isirayeli bayigishe Ivyagezwe vyawe. Bashikana imibavu imbere yawe, n’ibimazi bituriwe ku gicaniro cawe.
Hezagira ibikorwa vyabo, yewe Uhoraho , ushime ibikorwa vy’amaboko yabo. Vunagura amafyigo y’abansi babo, usiribange ababagwanya ntibasubire kuvyura umutwe.”
Ku muryango wa Benyamini Mose yavuze ati: “Uwo Uhoraho akunda namuruhukireko atekanirwe, kuko amukingira ibihe vyose, kandi uwo Uhoraho akunda, amuhe kuruhukira mu gikiriza ciwe.”
Ku ba Yosefu yavuze ati: “ Uhoraho ahezagire igihugu ciwe, agihezagize ikime kiva kw’ijuru, n’amazi ava mw’isi i kuzimu.
Abahezagize ivyamwa vyiza vyezwa n’izuba, n’ivyamwa vyera uko ukwezi guheze.
Abahe ivyimburwa vyo mu misozi ya kera, n’ivyo mu mitumba yamyeho,
bazogire imigisha yose yo kw’isi mu kunengesera kwayo n’ubuntu bw’iyari mu gisaka caka umuriro. Iyo migisha yose izobe ku mutwe wa Yosefu, isharize urugori rw’umuganwa muri benewabo.

Afise igihagararo nk’ic’impfizi nkuru, amahembe yiwe ameze nk’ay’impfizi y’imbogo. Ni yo azocumitisha amahanga, gushika no ku yari ku mpera y’isi. Abo ni ibihumbi cumi vy’Abefurayimu, n’ibihumbi vy’abo kwa Manase.”
Kuri Zebuloni na Isakari yavuze ati: “Nezerwa Zebuloni mu ngendo zawe, nawe Isakari, uhimbarwe mu mahema yawe.
Bazokoranya abantu ku musozi, banahashikanire ibimazi vy’ukugororoka; bazonezererwa umusesekara wo mu biyaga, n’itunga rihishijwe mu musenyi.”
Ku muryango wa Gadi yavuze ati: “Arahezagiwe uwagura intara ya Gadi. Gadi azohabunda nk’intambwe y’ingore, itantamura igitugu canke umutwe.
Abagadi bitoreye intara nziza, umugabane w’umurongozi watwawe na bo. Igihe abatware bari bakoraniye hamwe, Gadi yakoze ivyo kugororoka kw’ Uhoraho , yitondera n’ivyagezwe ku bwa Isirayeli.”
Ku muryango wa Dani Mose yavuze ati: “Dani ni icana c’intambwe, gisimvye kivuye i Bashani.”
Ku muryango wa Nafutali, Mose yavuze ati: “Ewe Nafutali, wuzuye ubuntu bw’ Uhoraho n’imihezagiro yiwe. Uzokwegukira ikiyaga n’igice c’ubumanuko.”
Kuri Asheri, yavuze ati: “Asheri arahezagiwe gusumba abandi benewabo bose; niyubahwe na benewabo, ibirenge vyiwe vyoge mu mavuta ya elayo.
Amarembo y’ibisagara vyiwe yugazwe ivyuma n’imiringa, yamane inkomezi imyaka y’ukubaho kwiwe yose.
Nta wuhwanye n’Imana yawe, yewe Yeshuruni, itambuka amajuru ije kugukiza, ikamanukana n’ibicu mu bwiza bwayo.
Uhoraho Imana ni we buhungiro bwawe, akureruye mu biganza vyiwe ibihe vyose. Azokwirukana abansi bawe imbere y’uko uvuga uti: ‘Barandure!’
Maze Isirayeli kizoheza kibe impore. Uruvyaro rwa Yakobo ruzoba amahoro, mu gihugu c’ingano n’umuvinyu mushasha, aho ijuru ritanga urume.

Urahezagiwe, yewe Isirayeli! Ni nde ameze nkawe, ubwoko bwakijijwe n’ Uhoraho ? Uhoraho ni we nkinzo yawe, ni we nkota yawe y’intsinzi. Abansi bawe bazoza bajugumira imbere yawe, nawe uzobahonyora ku gakanu.”
Nuko Mose aduga ku musozi Nebo avuye mu kiyaya c’i Mowabu, aja kw’isonga rya Pisiga, aharabana na Yeriko. Ahagaze aho, Uhoraho amwereka ca gihugu cose, kuva i Gileyadi gushika i Dani,
intara yose ya Nafutali, iya Efurayimu n’iya Manase, intara yose ya Yuda ishika ku Kiyaga Mediterane,
abona Negebu n’intara yose iva mu kiyaya ca Yeriko igaca mu gisagara c’ibigazi igashika i Zowari.

Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Ico ni co gihugu nasezeranishije indahiro Aburahamu na Isaka na Yakobo, igihe navuga nti: ‘Nzogiha uruvyaro rwanyu.’ Nakuretse ngo ukiboneshe amaso yawe, ariko ntuzojabuka ngo ucinjiremwo.”
Maze Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho aca apfira aho i Mowabu, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabivuze.
Amuhamba i Mowabu, mu kiyaya kirabana n’i Beti-Peyori, ariko gushika n’ubu nta wuzi aho imva yiwe iherereye.
Mose yapfuye amaze imyaka ijana na mirongo ibiri, ariko amaso yiwe yari akibona neza, kandi yari agifise inkomezi yamanye.
Maze Abisirayeli bagandarira Mose imisi mirongo itatu mu kiyaya ca Mowabu, gushika ikiringo co kugandara giheze.
Ico gihe Yosuwa mwene Nuni yari yuzuye impwemu y’ubwenge, kuko Mose yari yamurambitseko ibiganza. Maze Abisirayeli baramwumvira, bagakora ivyo Uhoraho yari yarategetse Mose vyose.
Kuva ico gihe, nta muvugishwa yasubiriye kubaho muri Isirayeli yangana na Mose, uwibonanira n’ Uhoraho amaso mu yandi,
uwakoze ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza nk’ivyo Uhoraho yatumye Mose gukora muri Egiputa, kuri Farawo no ku batware biwe, no ku gihugu cose.
Nta n’umwe yigeze akora ibikorwa bikomeye kandi biteye ubwoba nk’ivyo Mose yakoreye mu maso y’Abisirayeli bose.
